articles.title: Strengthening health systems to prioritise, provide care, and prevent osteoarthritis: a roadmap for global health policy
articles.authors: Briggs AM, Bowden JL, Risberg MA, Cross M, Callahan LF, Copenhaver CL, Dziedzic KS, Espinosa-Morales R, et al.

abstract.text: By 2050, almost 1 billion people are expected to live with osteoarthritis-a disabling musculoskeletal condition with currently no cure. Despite its burden and costs, osteoarthritis remains largely invisible in national and global health agendas, is poorly integrated within service models for other chronic health conditions, and is frequently perceived as inevitable with ageing and associated with limited therapeutic options. This context drives an osteoarthritis identity problem that fuels frustration among those living with the disease and health-care professionals, perpetuates stigma and inequities, undermines access to effective interventions, and crucially, deprioritises osteoarthritis in health policy. How can health systems be strengthened to mitigate the burden of disease and prioritise the prevention and control of osteoarthritis? We outline a co-created, globally relevant roadmap for health policy responses for osteoarthritis prevention and care that extend beyond the UN's Agenda 2030 targets. The intended audience for the roadmap includes health policy makers, health services managers, clinicians, and civil society organisations. The roadmap anchors to three strategic priorities underpinned by guiding principles of a life course approach, prioritising health equity, and ensuring that responses are affordable and sustainable across economies. Priority 1: recognise and respond to osteoarthritis with capacity building in national surveillance of burden, cost, and modifiable risk factors, and explicitly embedding musculoskeletal health within national and subnational health policies. Priority 2: scale up high-value, person-centred, equitable care for approximately 600 million people living with osteoarthritis. This priority requires reframing of societal narratives around osteoarthritis and reconfiguring service models to integrate osteoarthritis into primary and chronic disease care while also addressing social, environmental, and commercial determinants of musculoskeletal health. Priority 3: slow the osteoarthritis trajectory via primary and secondary prevention targeted at excess bodyweight and joint injury, enabled by cross-sectoral and cross-disease cooperation. These priorities are supported by accelerators requiring global collaboration, within and outside the osteoarthritis community.

articles.title: Addressing threats to future global health-what is the right timeframe?
articles.authors: Andreou C, Budolfson M, Campbell T, Ferranna M, Herlitz A, Kosonen P, Kowalczyk K, Lerner AJ, et al.

abstract.text: Our decisions today can support or threaten future human health. Insofar as we protect the planet or invest in fruitful research on pandemic countermeasures, we promote future wellbeing and health, sometimes at the present generation's expense. As we warm the planet, accelerate antibiotic resistance, or consume finite natural resources, we might serve present-day wellbeing or health at the expense of future generations. To decide which such trade-offs are legitimate or advisable, we need to know how to balance the health interests of future generations against each other and against our own. Should concerns for future health be confined to the 21st century as per the stated mission of the Lancet Commission on 21st century global threats to health? If not, how far into the future should they extend, and why? Population ethics is a branch of ethics that considers future populations' wellbeing. This Review, a part of the Lancet Commission on 21st century global threats to health, applies general insights from population ethics to future populations' health, and shows why that application is more complex than meets the eye.

articles.title: Retatrutide in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes (TRIUMPH-2): a double-blind, parallel-group, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Bellido V, le Roux CW, Ekinci EI, Bjornstad P, Frias JP, Giblin K, Eyde S, Park SY, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Retatrutide is an agonist of GIP, GLP-1, and glucagon receptors, and is currently under investigation for the treatment of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and other comorbidities, including knee osteoarthritis and obstructive sleep apnoea. We aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of retatrutide in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes.
abstract.textZh: Retatrutide是GIP、GLP-1和胰高血糖素受體的激動劑，目前正在研究用於治療肥胖、2型糖尿病和其他合併症，包括膝蓋骨關節炎和阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停。我們的目標是評估retatrutide在肥胖症和2型糖尿病成人中的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: TRIUMPH-2 was a double-blind, parallel-group, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial conducted at 92 medical and research centres and hospitals across eight countries. We enrolled adults (aged ≥18 years) with a BMI of 27 kg/m2 or higher and type 2 diabetes (glycated haemoglobin [HbA1c] 6·5-10·5%) on stable treatment for type 2 diabetes for at least 90 days before screening (diet or exercise alone, or up to three oral glucose-lowering medications), and a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce bodyweight. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1:1:1), using an interactive web-response system, to receive once-weekly subcutaneous injections (self-administered) of placebo or retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, or 12 mg. The primary endpoint was the percentage change from baseline to week 80 in bodyweight for the retatrutide 9 mg and 12 mg doses versus placebo, with 4 mg versus placebo a key secondary endpoint. Efficacy analyses included all randomly assigned participants, with missing data imputed with a primary multiple imputation strategy for the treatment regimen estimand. Safety analyses included all randomly assigned participants who received at least one dose of study drug. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05929079 (completed).
abstract.textZh: TRIUMPH-2是一項雙盲、平行組、隨機、安慰劑對照的3期試驗，在8個國家的92個醫療研究中心和醫院進行。 我們招募了BMI為27 kg/m2或更高的成年人（年齡≥ 18歲）和2型糖尿病（糖化血紅蛋白[HbA1c] 6.5-10.5 ％ ）在篩選前至少90天穩定治療2型糖尿病（單獨飲食或運動，或最多三種口服降糖藥物） ，並且至少有一次自我報告的飲食減肥失敗的歷史。 參與者被隨機分配（ 1: 1: 1: 1 ） ，使用互動式網絡反應系統，接受每週一次的安慰劑或retatrutide 4 mg、9 mg或12 mg的皮下注射（自我給藥）。 主要終點是retatrutide 9 mg和12 mg劑量對比安慰劑從基線到第80週體重的百分比變化，其中4 mg對比安慰劑是關鍵次要終點。 療效分析包括所有隨機分配的參與者，缺失的數據使用治療方案估計的主要多重估算策略進行估算。 安全性分析包括所有接受至少一劑研究藥物的隨機分配參與者。 本試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊， NCT05929079 （已完成）。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between July 11, 2023, and Nov 1, 2024, 2047 participants were screened, and 1152 (mean age 55·1 years [SD 10·8], 554 [48%] females and 598 [52%] males, and 672 [58%] of White ethnicity) were randomly assigned to retatrutide 4 mg (n=292), 9 mg (n=284), or 12 mg (n=287), or placebo (n=289). At baseline, the mean BMI was 38·2 kg/m2 (SD 7·4), mean HbA1c was 7·71% (1·07), median duration of obesity was 21 years (IQR 11-31), and median duration of diabetes was 5·6 years (2·6-10·4). At baseline, 1055 (92%) of 1152 participants were on any oral glucose-lowering medication, including biguanides, SGLT2 inhibitors, sulfonylureas, and other oral glucose-lowering medications. Of 1152 participants, 965 (84%) completed the study drug. For the treatment regimen estimand, the mean percentage change from baseline in bodyweight at week 80 was -11·9% (SE 0·6) with retatrutide 4 mg, -16·8% (0·7) with retatrutide 9 mg, -18·8% (0·7) with retatrutide 12 mg, and -5·1% (0·7) with placebo. Estimated treatment differences compared with placebo for percentage change in bodyweight were -6·9% (95% CI -8·7 to -5·1) with retatrutide 4 mg, -11·8% (-13·7 to -9·8) with retatrutide 9 mg, and -13·8% (-15·8 to -11·8) with retatrutide 12 mg (p<0·0001 for all). The most frequently reported adverse events were gastrointestinal, which were more common in the retatrutide groups than in the placebo group (diarrhoea occurred in 80 [27%] of 292 participants in the 4 mg group, 95 [34%] of 284 in the 9 mg group, and 96 [34%] of 286 in the 12 mg group vs 38 [13%] of 287 in the placebo group, and nausea occurred in 40 [14%], 59 [21%], and 80 [28%] vs 23 [8%]). Hypotension and dysesthesia were more frequent with retatrutide than with placebo (four [1%] in the 4 mg group, 14 [5%] in the 9 mg group, and 18 (6%) in the 12 mg group vs one [<1%] in the placebo group with hypotension; 13 [4%], 16 [6%], and 21 [7%] vs two [1%] in the placebo group with dysesthesia). Permanent treatment discontinuation due to adverse events or death was more frequent in participants treated with retatrutide 9 mg (33 [12%]) and 12 mg (22 [8%]) compared with retatrutide 4 mg (11 [4%]) and placebo (14 [5%]). Two participants died in the retatrutide 4 mg group, three in the 9 mg group, one in the 12 mg group, and one in the placebo group; all deaths were deemed to be unrelated to the study intervention by the investigator.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Treatment with retatrutide resulted in substantial improvements in bodyweight and was associated with improvements in glycaemic control in participants with obesity and type 2 diabetes, with a safety profile generally consistent with other molecules with GLP-1 receptor agonism. These results show that retatrutide might be effective for the treatment of obesity in people with type 2 diabetes.

articles.title: Radiotherapy versus observation following surgical resection of WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma (ROAM/EORTC-1308): an international, multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
articles.authors: Jenkinson MD, Rosala-Hallas A, Sahm F, Andratschke N, Ashkan K, Balestrini D, Bulbeck H, Comas S, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma is a primary brain tumour with a high risk of recurrence even after complete surgical resection. The role of adjuvant radiotherapy remains uncertain. We aimed to assess whether adjuvant radiotherapy reduces recurrence compared with observation in patients with a newly diagnosed atypical meningioma who have undergone complete surgical resection.
abstract.textZh: WHO第2級非典型腦膜瘤是原發性腦腫瘤，即使在完全手術切除後仍有高復發風險。輔助放射治療的作用仍然不確定。我們的目標是評估輔助放射治療與觀察相比，在經過完全手術切除的新診斷的非典型腦膜瘤患者中是否減少復發。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: ROAM/EORTC-1308 was an international, multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial, conducted at 58 hospitals and academic centres in 11 countries. Eligible sites had appropriate multidisciplinary expertise, neurosurgery, and radiotherapy facilities. Patients aged 16 years or older who had undergone a surgeon-assessed complete surgical resection of newly diagnosed atypical meningioma were randomly assigned (1:1) to adjuvant radiotherapy or observation. Randomisation was done using a web-based interface using random variable blocks of sizes two and four, stratified by location (UK or non-UK). Participants assigned to the radiotherapy group received fractionated external-beam intensity-modulated radiotherapy at a total dose of 60 Gy in 30 fractions over 6 weeks. Participants were followed up for a minimum of 4 years. The primary outcome was disease-free survival, defined as time from surgery to MRI-confirmed recurrence or death due to any cause, analysed in all randomly assigned participants in their assigned treatment group. Harms analysis was done in the as-treated population. The trial was registered with ISRCTN, ISRCTN71502099, and has completed.
abstract.textZh: ROAM/EORTC-1308是一項國際、多中心、開放標籤、3期、隨機對照試驗，在11個國家的58家醫院和學術中心進行。 符合資格的研究中心擁有適當的多學科專業知識、神經外科和放射治療設施。 接受外科醫生評估的新診斷非典型腦膜瘤完全手術切除的16歲或以上患者被隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）接受輔助放射治療或觀察。 隨機分組使用基於網絡的界面，使用大小為2和4的隨機變量塊，按地點（英國或非英國）分層。 分配到放射治療組的參與者在6週內以30次分次接受總劑量為60 Gy的分次外照射強度調節放射治療。 參與者被追蹤至少4年。 主要結果是無病生存期，定義為從手術到MRI確認復發或因任何原因死亡的時間，在其分配的治療組中所有隨機分配的參與者中進行分析。 在接受治療的人羣中進行了危害分析。 試驗已在ISRCTN （ ISRCTN71502099 ）註冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between April 28, 2016, and May 21, 2021, 990 patients were assessed for eligibility, 157 of whom were randomly assigned to radiotherapy (n=78) or observation (n=79). Median age was 57·40 years (IQR 49·09-66·93); 84 (54%) participants were female and 73 (46%) were male. At a median follow-up of 64 months (IQR 50-75), meningioma recurrence occurred in 11 (14%) of 78 participants in the radiotherapy group and 24 (30%) of 79 in the observation group. 5-year disease-free survival was 79·9% (95% CI 67·6-87·9) in the radiotherapy group and 64·3% (51·9-74·2) in the observation group (absolute difference 15·6% percentage points [95% CI 0·6-30·5]). Disease-free survival was improved in the radiotherapy group compared with the observation group (hazard ratio 0·51 [95% CI 0·27-0·97]; p=0·0396). Grade 2 or 3 radiation-related serious adverse events occurred in five (8%) of 66 participants in the radiotherapy group, with no treatment-related deaths.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Our findings suggest that adjuvant radiotherapy should be considered in patients with atypical meningioma after complete surgical resection of atypical meningioma when the prevention of recurrence is valued higher than the potential delayed adverse effects of radiotherapy. This practice will benefit patients by reducing meningioma recurrence. Decisions should be based on individual discussion with the patient.

articles.title: Developing roadmaps for advancing practice, research, and policy in the arts and health
articles.authors: Fancourt D, Bradt J, Fietje N, Tan MKB, Campbell D, Ibanez A, Sonke J, Patel V, et al.

abstract.text: Despite arts engagement being a ubiquitous human behaviour across human history, research and awareness on the health benefits of engagement are still emerging, accelerating over the past decade. Building on the evidence and research challenges outlined in the first paper of this Lancet collection, this Review puts forward a series of roadmaps for advancing research, policy, and practice to enable appropriate and effective integration of the arts into health and wellbeing systems globally. First and foremost, we advocate for the fundamental principle that all individuals, regardless of their characteristics and location, should have regular opportunities to engage in the arts, proposing policy and research steps to monitor and achieve this goal. Second, we emphasise the importance of implementing population-level strategies that use the arts as part of broader portfolios of approaches to help address the fundamental determinants of health inequities. Third, we underscore the necessity of developing and embedding across society diverse public-health pathways that connect individuals living with or at risk of health challenges to the arts within communities. Fourth, we argue for more clinical innovation in integrating bespoke evidence-based arts and creative arts therapies programmes into clinical care across the care pathway. Finally, we stress the crucial need for enhanced cross-sectoral stakeholder engagement and more strategic investment and research to facilitate the development and dissemination of the necessary tools, training, and evidence to achieve these objectives.

articles.title: Switch to injectable cabotegravir-rilpivirine given every 8 weeks in adolescents living with HIV with virological suppression in sub-Saharan Africa (LATA): a randomised, open-label, multicentre, 96-week non-inferiority trial
articles.authors: Bwakura-Dangarembizi M, Chappell E, Kityo C, Anena DL, Kiilu C, Archary M, Jafta L, Mujuru HA, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Adolescents living with HIV have poorer treatment outcomes than other age groups and might benefit from long-acting-injectable (LAI) antiretroviral therapy (ART). We evaluated efficacy and safety of LAI cabotegravir-rilpivirine compared with daily oral ART in adolescents living with HIV with virological suppression in Africa.
abstract.textZh: 艾滋病毒感染青少年的治療結果比其他年齡組差，可能受益於長效注射（ LAI ）抗逆轉錄病毒治療（ ART ）。我們評估了LAI cabotegravir-rilpivirine與日常口服藥物在非洲病毒抑制HIV感染青少年中的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: LATA, a randomised, open-label, multicentre, non-inferiority trial, recruited adolescents with HIV aged from 12 years to younger than 20 years from five clinics in Kenya, South Africa, Uganda, and Zimbabwe. Participants had to have virological suppression (HIV-1 viral load <50 copies per mL) for more than 12 months and no previous treatment failure. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive either LAI cabotegravir-rilpivirine (LAI group) or daily oral dolutegravir-lamivudine-tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TLD; control group). Randomisation was stratified by clinical centre and mode of infection (vertical vs horizontal or other). Participants, clinical staff, and researchers were unmasked to treatment allocation, whereas laboratory staff measuring viral loads were masked. Participants in the LAI group were assigned to receive cabotegravir (600 mg)-rilpivirine (900 mg) intramuscular injections at weeks 4, 8, 16, and every 8 weeks thereafter. Participants in the control group were assigned to receive the oral fixed-dose combination, dolutegravir (50 mg)-lamivudine (300 mg)-tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (300 mg), every day. Viral loads were measured every 24 weeks. The primary outcome was the proportion of participants with two consecutive (confirmed) viral load measurements equal to or higher than 50 copies per mL by week 96, estimated using adjusted Kaplan-Meier methods, by intention to treat. The non-inferiority margin and confidence level depended on the control event rate (8·9% margin, 99% CI, for 6% event rate). If non-inferiority was demonstrated, superiority was assessed at the α=5% level. This trial is completed and registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05154747.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between June 22, 2023, and April 15, 2024, 476 of 560 screened adolescents with HIV were enrolled in LATA and randomly assigned to either the LAI group (n=235) or the control group (n=241). Of the 476 randomised participants, 466 (98%) had acquired HIV vertically, and 200 (42%) were recruited from Uganda, 128 (27%) from Zimbabwe, 77 (16%) from Kenya, and 71 (15%) from South Africa. Median age was 16·5 years (IQR 14·8-18·1), 256 (54%) participants were female, 220 (46%) were male, 474 (>99%) were Black, and median duration of previous ART was 11·7 years (IQR 8·5-14·1). Median follow-up was 120 weeks (IQR 104-128). Two participants in the LAI group had confirmed viral load of 50 copies per mL or higher by week 96 (Kaplan-Meier estimated proportion 0·9%, 95% CI 0·0 to 2·2) versus 15 participants (6·4%, 3·7 to 9·8) in the control group (estimated difference -5·5%, 99% CI -10·3 to -1·5). LAI met the non-inferiority criterion and demonstrated superiority over control (p=0·0013). By the end of follow-up, seven participants permanently discontinued LAI (one confirmed viral load ≥200 copies per mL, two LAI-related adverse events [serious hypersensitivity reaction; non-serious drug eruption], one incident tuberculosis, two planning pregnancy, and one participant choice). There were 14 serious adverse events (in 14 participants) in the LAI group, including one homicide, compared with 18 (in 12 participants) in the control group, including one death from metastatic osteosarcoma (hazard ratio [HR] 1·16, 95% CI 0·54 to 2·51; p=0·71). The only treatment-related serious adverse event was hypersensitivity reaction. There were 31 adverse events of grade 3 or higher (in 27 participants) in the LAI group and 34 (in 26 participants) in the control group (HR 1·07, 0·62 to 1·83; 0·81). These events included four injection-site reactions (in the LAI group); otherwise, adverse event profiles were similar between trial groups.

abstract.text: In adolescents with HIV with virological suppression, LAI cabotegravir-rilpivirine was superior to TLD for maintaining virological suppression, with no new safety concerns observed. articles.title: Advances in Systemic Treatment of Breast Cancer
articles.authors: Hurvitz SA

abstract.text: Systemic therapy for breast cancer has evolved rapidly since 2020, driven by the expansion of targeted therapies, antibody-drug conjugates, and immunotherapy across biologic subtypes. The integration of tumor molecular profiling and germline testing has enabled increasingly personalized, biomarker-guided treatment strategies. In hormone-receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative disease, cyclin-dependent kinase 4 and 6 inhibitors remain foundational, whereas phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase pathway inhibitors, oral selective estrogen-receptor degraders, and antibody-drug conjugates have transformed disease management after endocrine resistance. In HER2-positive disease, antibody-drug conjugates - particularly trastuzumab deruxtecan - have improved outcomes and are being used in earlier lines of therapy, a development that is reshaping treatment paradigms. In triple-negative breast cancer, immune checkpoint inhibitors have improved outcomes in both metastatic and early-stage disease. Across subtypes, advances in curative therapy increasingly emphasize risk-adapted escalation and de-escalation of treatment. Ongoing challenges include improving treatment sequencing, identifying predictive biomarkers, integrating emerging tools such as analysis of circulating tumor DNA, and ensuring equitable access to high-cost therapies.
abstract.textZh: 自2020年以來，由於靶向療法、抗體-藥物偶聯物和免疫療法在生物亞型上的擴展，乳腺癌的全身治療發展迅速。 腫瘤分子特徵分析和種系檢測的整合促成了越來越個人化的生物標記引導治療策略。 在激素受體陽性的人表皮生長因子受體2 （ HER2 ）陰性疾病中，週期蛋白依賴性激酶4和6抑制劑仍然是基礎，而磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶途徑抑制劑、口服選擇性雌激素受體降解劑和抗體-藥物偶聯物在內分泌抵抗後改變了疾病管理。 在HER2陽性疾病中，抗體-藥物結合物-特別是曲妥珠單抗德魯克替康-具有改善的結果，並被用於早期的治療線路，這是一種正在重塑治療範式的發展。 在三陰性乳腺癌中，免疫檢查點抑制劑改善了轉移性和早期疾病的結果。 在各亞型中，治療性治療的進步越來越強調治療的風險適應升級和降級。 持續的挑戰包括改善治療排序、識別預測性生物標誌物、整合循環腫瘤DNA分析等新興工具，以及確保公平獲得高成本療法。

articles.authors: Sasieni P, Johnson P, Round T, Warwick J, Jones H, Dolly S, Lee L, Lee Y, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Whether screening with blood-based early-detection tests for multiple cancers in addition to usual care has clinical utility is unknown.
abstract.textZh: 除了日常護理外，對多種癌症進行血液早期檢測篩查是否具有臨牀實用性尚不清楚。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a randomized, controlled trial conducted in England, we obtained peripheral blood from persons 50 to 77 years of age at up to three annual visits. After baseline blood collection, participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to the intervention group (participants whose blood was tested) or the control group (participants whose blood was stored). Participants and trial personnel were initially unaware of the group assignments. The primary end point was stage III or IV cancer among 12 prespecified types of cancer, and a key secondary end point was stage IV cancer among the 12 prespecified types. The differences between the groups in the incidence rate (the number of first eligible events divided by person-years at risk) were measured after three screening rounds and at least 12 months of follow-up after the last participant's third visit.
abstract.textZh: 在英國進行的一項隨機、對照試驗中，我們在至多三次年度回診中從50至77歲的人羣中獲得外周血。基線期血液採集後，參與者以1: 1的比例被隨機分配到幹預組（接受血液測試的參與者）或對照組（儲存血液的參與者）。參與者和試驗人員最初不知道小組分配。在12種預先指定的癌症類型中，主要終點是III期或IV期癌症，而在12種預先指定的癌症類型中，關鍵次要終點是IV期癌症。在三次篩選回合和最後一位參與者第三次回診後至少12個月的追蹤後，測量各組之間的發生率差異（第一次合格事件的數量除以風險人年）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 71,122 participants were randomly assigned to the intervention group and 71,128 to the control group. The incidence rate of stage III or IV cancer (primary end point) did not differ significantly between the groups (incidence rate ratio [intervention vs. control], 1.03; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.92 to 1.14, P = 0.63). The incidence rate ratio for stage IV cancer (a key secondary end point) after 3 screening rounds was 0.86 (95% CI, 0.74 to 1.00). Less than 1% of participants had trial-related adverse events; none were serious.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 71,122名參與者被隨機分配到幹預組， 71,128名參與者被隨機分配到對照組。III期或IV期癌症（主要終點）的發生率在各組之間沒有顯著差異（發生率比率[幹預對照] ， 1.03 ； 95%可信區間[CI] ， 0.92至1.14 ， P = 0.63 ）。3輪篩選後IV期癌症（關鍵次要終點）的發病率比率為0.86 （ 95% CI ， 0.74至1.00 ）。不到1%的受試者出現與試驗相關的不良事件；沒有嚴重不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In this trial, we did not observe a lower incidence rate of stage III or IV cancers across 12 prespecified cancers after three screening rounds with multicancer early-detection testing plus usual care than with usual care alone. Further follow-up is warranted to assess the way in which findings for stage III or IV cancers and the between-group difference in stage IV cancers evolve over time. (Funded by Grail; NHS-Galleri ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05611632; ISRCTN number, ISRCTN91431511.).
abstract.textZh: 在這項試驗中，我們並未觀察到12種預先指定癌症的III期或IV期癌症發生率在三次篩選回合後，通過多癌早期檢測加上常規護理，比單獨使用常規護理更低。需要進一步追蹤以評估III期或IV期癌症的發現以及IV期癌症的組間差異隨著時間演變的方式。（由GRAIL資助； NHS-Galleri ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05611632 ； ISRCTN編號， ISRCTN91431511。）。

articles.title: Tricuspid-Valve Intervention in Heart Failure
articles.authors: Hausleiter J, Stocker TJ, Geisler T, Lurz P, Rottbauer W, Lubos E, Schofer N, Frerker C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The effect of transcatheter tricuspid-valve repair on clinical outcomes, including death and hospitalization for heart failure, in patients with severe tricuspid regurgitation remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 在嚴重三尖瓣反流的患者中，經導管三尖瓣修復對臨牀結果（包括心力衰竭的死亡和住院）的影響仍然不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We randomly assigned patients with symptomatic severe tricuspid regurgitation and an increased risk of future heart-failure events in a 2:1 ratio to tricuspid-valve repair plus medical therapy (tricuspid-repair group) or medical therapy alone (medical-therapy group). The first primary end point was a hierarchical composite of death from any cause, hospitalization for heart failure, and quality-of-life improvement at 1 year, assessed by win ratio. If the between-group difference was significant, a second primary end point would be tested: a composite of death from any cause or hospitalization for heart failure through 3 years.
abstract.textZh: 我們以2: 1的比例將症狀嚴重三尖瓣反流和未來心力衰竭事件風險增加的患者隨機分配到三尖瓣修復加藥物治療（三尖瓣修復組）或單獨藥物治療（醫療治療組）。第一個主要終點是任何原因導致的死亡、心力衰竭住院治療和1年生活品質改善的分層綜合評估，以勝率評估。如果組間差異顯著，則將測試第二個主要終點：任何原因導致的死亡或3年內因心力衰竭住院治療的綜合結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 360 patients underwent randomization (237 patients were assigned to the tricuspid-repair group and 123 to the medical-therapy group). The mean (±SD) age of the patients was 80.3±6.4 years, and 56.4% were women. The win ratio for the first primary end point was 2.42 (95% confidence interval [CI], 1.76 to 3.33; P<0.001), favoring tricuspid-valve repair. The Kaplan-Meier estimate for freedom from death from any cause or hospitalization for heart failure (second primary end point) through 3 years was 52.4% (95% CI, 43.2 to 63.6) in the tricuspid-repair group and 21.0% (95% CI, 12.7 to 34.6) in the medical-therapy group (hazard ratio for death from any cause or hospitalization for heart failure, 0.40; 95% CI, 0.29 to 0.55; P<0.001). Major adverse events within 30 days occurred in 14 patients (5.9%) in the tricuspid-repair group.
abstract.textZh: 共有360名患者接受隨機分組（ 237名患者被分配到三尖瓣修復組， 123名患者被分配到醫療組）。患者的平均(± SD)年齡為80.3 ± 6.4歲，女性為56.4%。第一個主要終點的勝率為2.42 （ 95 ％置信區間[CI] ， 1.76至3.33 ； P < 0.001 ） ，有利於三尖瓣修復。在三尖瓣修復組中， Kaplan-Meier對於心力衰竭（第二個主要終點）在3年內因任何原因死亡或住院的自由度估計為52.4% （ 95% CI ， 43.2至63.6 ） ，在醫療治療組中為21.0% （ 95% CI ， 12.7至34.6 ） （任何原因死亡或心力衰竭住院的風險比為0.40 ； 95% CI ， 0.29至0.55 ； P < 0.001 ）。三尖瓣修復組中14名患者(5.9%)在30天內發生重大不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with symptomatic severe tricuspid regurgitation, transcatheter tricuspid-valve repair plus medical therapy was superior to medical therapy alone with respect to a hierarchical composite of death from any cause, hospitalization for heart failure, and quality-of-life improvement at 1 year and was also associated with a lower risk of a composite of death from any cause or hospitalization for heart failure through 3 years. (Funded by the German Center for Cardiovascular Research and others; TRIC-I-HF ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04634266.).
abstract.textZh: 在有症狀嚴重三尖瓣反流的患者中，經導管三尖瓣修復加上藥物治療，在任何原因導致的死亡、心力衰竭住院治療和1年生活質量改善的分層綜合治療方面優於單用藥物治療，並且在3年內與任何原因導致的死亡綜合治療或心力衰竭住院治療的風險降低相關。（由德國心血管研究中心等資助； TRIC-I-HF ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT04634266 ）。

articles.title: Vasopressors or Fluids in Early Septic Shock
articles.authors: ARISE FLUIDS Investigators, the ANZICS Clinical Trials Group, and the ACEM Clinical Trials Network, Peake SL, Macdonald SPJ, Howe BD, Milford E, Jones P, Arendts G, Bailey M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The optimal approach to early resuscitation in septic shock is unknown. Equipoise exists between the use of larger volumes of intravenous fluids to restore perfusion and the use of early vasopressor therapy along with smaller volumes of fluids to minimize potential harm from excess fluid.
abstract.textZh: 感染性休克早期復蘇的最佳方法尚不清楚。在使用較大容量的靜脈注射液恢復灌注與使用早期血管加壓療法以及較小容量的液體以最大限度地減少過量液體的潛在危害之間存在平衡。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We randomly assigned adult patients who presented to the emergency department with septic shock to receive either fluids at restricted volumes and early vasopressor therapy (vasopressor group) or higher volumes of fluids and later vasopressor therapy (fluids group) for at least 6 hours and up to 24 hours. The primary outcome was days alive and out of the hospital from randomization to day 90.
abstract.textZh: 我們隨機分配在急診室出現敗血性休克的成年患者接受限制體積的液體和早期血管加壓療法（血管加壓療法組）或更高體積的液體和後來的血管加壓療法（液體組） ，持續至少6小時至24小時。主要結果是從隨機分組到第90天的存活天數和出院天數。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 1000 patients underwent randomization, with 499 assigned to the vasopressor group and 501 to the fluids group. Informed consent was not obtained for 37 patients, which left 963 patients in the intention-to-treat population (481 in the vasopressor group and 482 in the fluids group). Three patients in the fluids group were lost to follow-up for the primary outcome. In the first 24 hours after randomization, patients in the vasopressor group received less intravenous fluid than those in the fluids group (median difference, -1108 ml; 95% confidence interval [CI], -1395 to -850). The percentage of patients who received vasopressors was higher by 18.9 percentage points (95% CI, 13.3 to 24.5) in the vasopressor group. The median number of days alive and out of the hospital at day 90 was 76 (interquartile range, 55 to 83) in the vasopressor group and 76 (interquartile range, 55 to 82) in the fluids group (difference, 0.0 days; 95% CI, -2.7 to 2.7; P = 1.00). Adverse events occurred in similar percentages of patients in the two groups, except for pulmonary edema (0.6% in the vasopressor group vs. 5.0% in the fluids group; P<0.001).
abstract.textZh: 共有1000名患者接受隨機分組，其中499名分配到血管加壓器組， 501名分配到液體組。 37名患者未獲得知情同意，這使得963名患者在意向治療人羣中（ 481名在血管加壓組， 482名在液體組）。 液體組中有三名患者失去了對主要結果的追蹤。 在隨機分組後的前24小時內，血管加壓劑組的患者接受的靜脈輸液量少於液體組（中位差， -1108 ml ； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -1395至-850 ）。 接受血管加壓藥的患者百分比在血管加壓藥組中高出18.9個百分點（ 95 ％ CI ， 13.3至24.5 ）。 第90天的存活和出院天數中位數在血管壓縮器組為76 （四分位數範圍， 55至83 ） ，在液體組為76 （四分位數範圍， 55至82 ） （差異， 0.0天； 95% CI ， -2.7至2.7 ； P = 1.00 ）。 兩組患者的不良事件發生率相似，但肺水腫除外（血管加壓劑組為0.6% ，液體組為5.0% ； P < 0.001 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among adult patients who presented to the emergency department with septic shock, an approach that involved restricted fluid volume and early vasopressors did not result in a greater number of days alive and out of the hospital at day 90 than an approach involving greater fluid volume and later administration of vasopressors. (Funded by the Australian National Health and Medical Council Medical Research Future Fund and the New Zealand Health Research Council; ARISE FLUIDS ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04569942.).
abstract.textZh: 在急診室出現敗血性休克的成年患者中，涉及限制液體體積和早期血管加壓劑的方法並沒有導致第90天的存活和出院天數比涉及更大液體體積和後來施用血管加壓劑的方法更多。（由澳大利亞國家衛生和醫學委員會醫學研究未來基金和新西蘭衛生研究委員會資助； ARISE FLUIDS ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT04569942。）。

articles.title: Nicotinamide Riboside for Patients With Early-Stage Parkinson Disease: The NOPARK Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Brakedal B, Skeie GO, Derad C, Alstadhaug KB, Anundskås I, Berven H, Biermann M, Bjørnarå KA, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Nicotinamide riboside, a nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide precursor, has been proposed as a potential disease-modifying therapy for Parkinson disease based on preclinical and early studies. Whether prolonged oral nicotinamide riboside improves clinical outcomes in Parkinson disease is unknown.
abstract.textZh: 煙酰胺核苷是一種煙酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸前體，已根據臨牀前和早期研究提出作為帕金森病的潛在疾病修飾療法。長期口服煙酰胺核苷是否能改善帕金森病的臨牀結果尚不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether nicotinamide riboside improves clinical outcomes in Parkinson disease compared with placebo.
abstract.textZh: 確定與安慰劑相比，煙酰胺核苷是否能改善帕金森病的臨牀結果。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 clinical trial conducted at 11 centers in Norway. Eligible participants were patients aged 35 years or older with Parkinson disease diagnosed within 2 years before enrollment, Hoehn and Yahr disease stage less than 3, abnormal dopamine transporter scintigraphy findings confirming dopaminergic nigrostriatal denervation, and stable dopaminergic treatment before enrollment. Of 537 screened individuals, 410 were randomized from May 6, 2020, to June 20, 2024, and 393 were included in the primary analysis. Final follow-up was completed on June 19, 2025.
abstract.textZh: 在挪威11個中心進行的隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、3期臨牀試驗。符合資格的參與者是35歲或以上的帕金森病患者，在入組前2年內被診斷為帕金森病， Hoehn和Yahr疾病分期小於3期，多巴胺轉運蛋白閃爍檢查結果異常，確認多巴胺能黑色紋狀體去神經，以及入組前穩定的多巴胺能治療。在537名篩選的個體中， 410名從2020年5月6日至2024年6月20日隨機分組， 393名被納入主要療效分析。最終追蹤已於2025年6月19日完成。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomized to receive oral nicotinamide riboside, 500 mg twice daily (n = 206), or matching placebo (n = 204) for 52 weeks.
abstract.textZh: 患者被隨機分配接受口服煙酰胺核苷， 500毫克，每日兩次（ n = 206 ） ，或對應的安慰劑（ n = 204 ） ，持續52週。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was change from baseline to week 52 in the Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale total score (MDS-UPDRS parts I-III; range, 0-236, with higher scores indicating more severe disease; clinically important differences for improvement and worsening, 6.7 and 5.2 points, respectively), analyzed using a mixed model for repeated measures. The 5 key secondary outcomes were the individual parts I, II, and III of the MDS-UPDRS; dopamine transporter single-photon emission computed tomography brain imaging findings; and the Non-Motor Symptoms Scale score (NMSS; range, 0-360, with higher scores indicating greater nonmotor symptom burden).
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是運動障礙協會統一帕金森病評分量表總分(MDS-UPDRS第I-III部分；範圍0-236 ，分數越高表示疾病越嚴重；改善和惡化的臨牀重要差異分別為6.7分和5.2分)從基線到第52週的變化，使用混合模型進行重複測量。5個關鍵次要結果是MDS-UPDRS的個別I、II和III部分；多巴胺轉運蛋白單光子發射電腦斷層掃描腦成像結果；以及非運動症狀量表評分（ NMSS ；範圍為0-360 ，分數越高表示非運動症狀負擔越大）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among the 393 participants in the primary analysis, the mean age was 65.6 (SD, 9.4) years and 133 (34%) were female. At week 52, the total MDS-UPDRS score increased by 2.45 (95% CI, 0.80-4.10) points with nicotinamide riboside and decreased by 0.27 (95% CI, -1.95 to 1.40) points with placebo, yielding an adjusted mean difference of 2.72 points (95% CI, 0.47-4.98 points; P = .02), favoring placebo. Of the 5 prespecified key secondary outcomes, 4 showed no significant difference, but nonmotor symptom burden worsened more with nicotinamide riboside (NMSS score adjusted mean difference, 4.22 [95% CI, 1.07-7.37] points; P = .009). Serious adverse events occurred in 17 (8.3%) of 205 participants receiving nicotinamide riboside and 29 (14.1%) of 205 receiving placebo in the safety population.
abstract.textZh: 在主要療效分析的393名參與者中，平均年齡為65.6 (SD ， 9.4)歲， 133 (34%)名為女性。在第52週，使用煙酰胺核苷的MDS-UPDRS總分增加了2.45 (95% CI ， 0.80-4.10)分，使用安慰劑的MDS-UPDRS總分減少了0.27 (95% CI ， -1.95-1.40)分，調整後的平均差值為2.72分(95% CI ， 0.47-4.98分； P = 0.02) ，有利於安慰劑。在5個預先指定的關鍵次要結果中， 4個顯示出無顯著差異，但使用煙酰胺核苷的非運動症狀負擔惡化更多（ NMSS分數調整平均差異， 4.22 [95% CI ， 1.07-7.37]分； P = 0.009 ）。在安全性人羣中，接受煙酰胺核苷的205名參與者中有17名（ 8.3% ）發生嚴重不良事件，接受安慰劑的205名參與者中有29名（ 14.1% ）發生嚴重不良事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Among patients with early Parkinson disease, nicotinamide riboside treatment for 52 weeks did not improve clinical outcomes and was associated with worse clinical outcomes than placebo. These findings do not support nicotinamide riboside as a disease-modifying treatment for Parkinson disease.
abstract.textZh: 在患有早期帕金森病的患者中，煙酰胺核苷治療52週並未改善臨牀結果，且與安慰劑相比臨牀結果更差。這些發現並不支持煙酰胺核苷作為帕金森病的疾病修飾治療。

articles.title: Advance Care Planning for Black and White Older Adults With Serious Illness: The EQUAL ACP Randomized Trial
articles.authors: Johnson KS, Ejem D, Platt A, Olsen M, Quest T, Barrett N, Rhodes R, Gangavati A, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Advance care planning (ACP) helps individuals communicate preferences for future medical care. Many adults do not participate in ACP, and Black adults are less likely than White adults to participate.
abstract.textZh: 預先照護計劃（ ACP ）可幫助個人溝通對未來醫療照護的偏好。許多成人不參與ACP ，黑人成人比白人成人參與的可能性更低。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare the effectiveness of facilitated vs self-guided ACP interventions.
abstract.textZh: 比較促進型與自我引導型ACP幹預的有效性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: EQUAL ACP was a multisite, cluster randomized trial conducted in 10 primary care (n = 9) and geriatrics (n = 1) clinics in the South of the United States. Participants were community-dwelling Black and White adults 65 years or older with serious illness. Within each clinic and study group, participants were randomized to a racially concordant or discordant ACP facilitator.
abstract.textZh: EQUAL ACP是一項多站點、叢集隨機試驗，在美國南部的10家初級保健(n = 9)和老年醫學(n = 1)診所進行。參與者是居住在社區的65歲或以上患有嚴重疾病的黑人和白人成年人。在每個診所和研究組中，參與者被隨機分配到種族一致或不一致的ACP促進者。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Clinics were randomized to Respecting Choices First Steps, a facilitated ACP approach, or Five Wishes, a self-guided approach. Both were delivered by lay ACP facilitators.
abstract.textZh: 診所被隨機分配到Respecting Choices First Steps （促進ACP方法）或Five Wishes （自我引導方法）。兩者都由非專業的ACP協調員提供。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: ACP completion within 12 months after the baseline survey, defined as new formal (advance directive, clinician note, or orders for life-sustaining treatment form in the medical record) and/or new informal ACP (participant-reported discussion with family about end-of-life care preferences). The primary analysis compared the effectiveness of the self-guided approach with the facilitated approach within each racial group. Other analyses assessed interaction between race and treatment in the combined sample and the association of participant-facilitator racial concordance with ACP.
abstract.textZh: 在基線期調查後12個月內完成ACP ，定義為新的正式（預先指示、臨牀醫生備註或醫療記錄中維持生命治療表單的訂單）和/或新的非正式ACP （參與者報告與家人討論臨終護理偏好）。主要分析比較了每個種族羣體中自我引導方法和促進方法的有效性。其他分析評估了合併樣本中種族和治療之間的相互作用，以及參與者-主持人種族一致性與ACP的關聯。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 791 participants, 427 were Black and 364 were White; 409 were in clinics with the facilitated approach and 382 in clinics with the self-guided approach. Among Black participants, 152 of 213 (71%) in facilitated clinics and 131 of 213 (62%) in self-guided clinics completed ACP within 1 year (adjusted risk ratio [RR], 1.15 [95% CI, 0.83-1.59]). Among White participants, 133 of 196 (68%) in facilitated clinics and 131 of 167 (78%) in self-guided clinics completed ACP (adjusted RR, 0.88 [95% CI, 0.65-1.18]). Among 789 in the pooled sample, 547 (69%) completed ACP, including 130 of 789 with formal ACP and 523 of 668 with informal ACP. In the pooled sample, the interaction between race and intervention group was significant (adjusted RR, 1.32 [95% CI, 1.03-1.69]), indicating greater effectiveness of the facilitated vs self-guided approach among Black relative to White participants. Participant-facilitator racial concordance was not associated with ACP in either racial group.
abstract.textZh: 在791名參與者中， 427名是黑人， 364名是白人； 409名在使用簡化方法的診所， 382名在使用自我引導方法的診所。在黑人參與者中，輔助診所的213人中有152人（ 71 ％ ） ，自助診所的213人中有131人（ 62 ％ ）在1年內完成了ACP （調整後的風險比[RR] ， 1.15 [95 ％ CI ， 0.83-1.59] ）。在白人參與者中，輔助診所的196人中有133人（ 68 ％ ） ，自助診所的167人中有131人（ 78 ％ ）完成了ACP （調整後RR ， 0.88 [95 ％ CI ， 0.65-1.18] ）。在匯總樣本中的789例中， 547例（ 69% ）完成了ACP ，其中789例中有130例完成了正式ACP ， 668例中有523例完成了非正式ACP。在匯集的樣本中，種族和幹預組之間的相互作用是顯著的（調整後的RR ， 1.32 [95% CI ， 1.03-1.69] ） ，表明黑人與白人參與者相比，促進型與自我引導型方法更有效。在任何一個種族羣體中，參與者-培訓人員的種族一致性都與ACP無關。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: ACP completion within 1 year did not differ significantly between facilitated vs self-guided ACP approaches within Black or White racial groups.
abstract.textZh: 在黑人或白人種族羣體中， 1年內完成的ACP在協助與自我引導的ACP方法之間沒有顯著差異。

articles.title: Effect of Fluvoxamine and Metformin for Fatigue in Patients With Long COVID : An Adaptive Randomized Trial
articles.authors: Reis G, Dos Santos Moreira Silva EA, Medeiros Silva DC, Thabane L, Santiago Ferreira T, Reis LLF, Figueiredo Guimaraes Almeida AP, Menezes Amaral M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Postacute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (long COVID) presents a therapeutic challenge, with fatigue being a common, debilitating symptom.
abstract.textZh: SARS-CoV-2感染（長期COVID ）的急性後遺症是一種治療挑戰，疲勞是一種常見的衰弱症狀。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess the efficacy of fluvoxamine and metformin to treat long COVID fatigue.
abstract.textZh: 評估氟伏沙明和二甲雙胍治療長期COVID疲勞的功效。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Randomized, placebo-controlled, adaptive trial. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06128967).
abstract.textZh: 隨機、安慰劑對照、適應性試驗。（ ClinicalTrials.gov ： NCT06128967 ）。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Outpatient sites in Brazil.
abstract.textZh: 巴西的門診部位。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 399 adults with fatigue 90 days to 24 months after confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection.
abstract.textZh: 399名成人在確診SARS-CoV-2感染後90天至24個月內感到疲勞。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Participants were randomly assigned to fluvoxamine (100 mg twice daily [BID]), extended-release metformin (750 mg BID [n = 71] from October 2023 to April 2024; reduced to 500 mg BID [n = 40] in May 2024 after a protocol amendment until the group was stopped for futility in September 2024), or a matching placebo, each for 60 days with follow-up to day 90.
abstract.textZh: 參與者被隨機分配到氟伏沙明（ 100毫克，每日兩次[BID] ）、延長釋放二甲雙胍（ 2023年10月至2024年4月為750毫克BID [n = 71] ；在計畫書修正後於2024年5月降至500毫克BID [n = 40] ，直到2024年9月該組因無效而停止服用）或相應的安慰劑，每種治療60天，並追蹤至第90天。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Change in Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS) score.
abstract.textZh: 疲勞嚴重程度量表(FSS)分數的變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Median baseline FSS scores ranged from 5.6 to 5.9 across all study groups. The treatment effect on FSS score for fluvoxamine versus placebo showed a mean difference of -0.43 at day 60 and -0.58 at day 90; both had a posterior probability of superiority of 99%. Fluvoxamine also improved quality-of-life scores with a high posterior probability of superiority. Findings for metformin were inconclusive. Incidence of adverse events was lower for fluvoxamine (24.0%) than for metformin, 750 mg BID (45.1%); metformin, 500 mg BID (42.5%); and placebo (35.5%). Grade 3 or higher adverse events were rare (≤2.7%), with no treatment-related deaths.
abstract.textZh: 所有研究組的基線FSS分數中位數範圍為5.6至5.9。氟伏沙明與安慰劑對FSS評分的治療效果顯示，第60天時的平均差異為-0.43 ，第90天時的平均差異為-0.58 ；兩者的後天優勢概率為99%。Fluvoxamine還改善了生活質量分數，具有較高的優越性後期概率。二甲雙胍的結果尚無定論。氟伏沙明（ 24.0% ）的不良事件發生率低於二甲雙胍（ 750 mg BID ， 45.1% ）、二甲雙胍（ 500 mg BID ， 42.5% ）和安慰劑（ 35.5% ）。3級或以上不良事件罕見（ ≤ 2.7% ） ，且無治療相關死亡。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: The results were inconclusive for metformin because of a dose change recommended by the data safety and monitoring committee due to adverse effects causing study withdrawal and early termination. The benefit of fluvoxamine after 90 days is unknown. The trial did not address other long COVID symptoms.
abstract.textZh: 由於數據安全和監測委員會建議改變劑量，導致研究退出和提前終止的不良影響，因此二甲雙胍的結果尚無定論。氟伏沙明90天後的益處尚不清楚。該試驗沒有解決其他長期的COVID症狀。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Fluvoxamine shows potential for improving long COVID-associated fatigue and quality of life.
abstract.textZh: 氟伏沙明顯示出改善長期COVID相關疲勞和生活質量的潛力。

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: The Latona Foundation.
abstract.textZh: Latona基金會。

articles.title: Pharmacologic Treatments for Females With Menopausal Vasomotor Symptoms: A Clinical Guideline From the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: Qaseem A, Mackey K, Yost J, Shekelle PG, Shamliyan TA, Cross JT, Clinical Guidelines Committee of the American College of Physicians

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: The American College of Physicians (ACP) developed this clinical guideline on pharmacologic treatments for internal medicine physicians and other clinicians caring in outpatient settings for females with menopausal vasomotor symptoms.
abstract.textZh: 美國醫師學會（ ACP ）為內科醫生和其他臨牀醫生開發了這項臨牀治療指南，這些醫生在門診環境中為更年期血管舒縮症狀的女性提供護理。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: The ACP Clinical Guidelines Committee developed this guideline based on systematic reviews on effectiveness, comparative effectiveness, harms, public and patient values and preferences, and economic evidence of pharmacologic treatments for females with menopausal vasomotor symptoms using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation) approach.
abstract.textZh: ACP臨牀指南委員會基於對有效性、比較有效性、危害、公眾和患者價值觀和偏好的系統審查，以及使用GRADE （建議分級、評估、發展和評估）方法對更年期血管舒張症徵狀的女性進行藥物治療的經濟證據，制定了本指南。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATION
abstract.text: In females who are seeking treatment of vasomotor symptoms.
abstract.textZh: 正在尋求血管舒張症狀治療的女性。

abstract.text: First-line treatments.
abstract.textZh: 一線治療。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: ACP recommends that clinicians initiate one of the following (strong recommendation): estrogen in combination with progestogen in females with a uterus (high-certainty evidence) or estrogen monotherapy in females without a uterus (high-certainty evidence).
abstract.textZh: ACP建議臨牀醫生進行以下任一治療（強烈建議） ：雌激素與孕激素合併治療有子宮的女性（高確定性證據） ，或雌激素單一治療無子宮的女性（高確定性證據）。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: Second-line treatments.
abstract.textZh: 二線治療。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: ACP suggests that clinicians use one of the following in females who have contraindications to or do not tolerate first-line treatment (conditional recommendation): serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, either desvenlafaxine or venlafaxine (moderate-certainty evidence).
abstract.textZh: ACP建議臨牀醫生對一線治療有禁忌症或不耐受一線治療的女性使用以下藥物之一（有條件建議） ：血清素-去甲腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑，無論是去芬拉法辛還是文拉法辛（中等確定性證據）。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: Third-line treatments.

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: ACP suggests that clinicians use one of the following in females who have contraindications to or do not tolerate first-line or second-line treatment (conditional recommendation): selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, either escitalopram or paroxetine (low-certainty evidence); the gabapentinoid gabapentin (low-certainty evidence); or neurokinin receptor antagonists, either elinzanetant or fezolinetant (moderate-certainty evidence).
abstract.textZh: ACP建議臨牀醫生在具有一線或二線治療禁忌症或不耐受一線或二線治療的女性中使用以下藥物之一（有條件建議） ：選擇性血清素再攝取抑制劑，無論是escitalopram還是paroxetine （低確定性證據） ；加巴噴丁類加巴噴丁（低確定性證據） ；或神經激肽受體拮抗劑，無論是elinzanetant還是fezolinetant （中等確定性證據）。

articles.title: Pharmacologic Treatments for Female Menopausal Vasomotor Symptoms: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis for the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: Diem S, Landsteiner A, Langsetmo L, Ullman K, Zerzan N, Danan E, MacDonald R, Greer N, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Vasomotor symptoms (VMS) are common in perimenopausal and postmenopausal females.
abstract.textZh: 血管緊縮症狀（ VMS ）在更年期和絕經後女性中很常見。

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: To evaluate benefits, harms, patient values and preferences, and cost-effectiveness of pharmacologic treatments for VMS.
abstract.textZh: 評估VMS藥物治療的益處、危害、患者價值和偏好以及成本效益。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: MEDLINE ALL, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials from inception to 3 March 2026.
abstract.textZh: 從開始到2026年3月3日， MEDLINE ALL、Embase和Cochrane中央對照試驗登記冊。

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Randomized trials of at least 8 weeks' duration of eligible medications in females with VMS reporting VMS frequency and severity, menopause-related quality of life (QoL), sleep quality, endometrial hyperplasia or cancer, and/or serious adverse events (SAEs); U.S. Food and Drug Administration and European Medicines Agency labels for additional harms.
abstract.textZh: 針對VMS的女性進行至少8週合格藥物的隨機試驗，報告VMS頻率和嚴重程度、更年期相關的生活質量（ QOL ）、睡眠質量、子宮內膜增生或癌症和/或嚴重不良事件（ SAE ） ；美國食品藥物管理局和歐洲藥物管理局標籤為其他危害。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Data were abstracted by 1 reviewer and verified by a second reviewer. Independent, dual risk-of-bias assessments were performed. Certainty of evidence (COE) was assessed by 1 reviewer and overread by a second reviewer.
abstract.textZh: 數據由1名審核人員提取，並由第二名審核人員驗證。進行了獨立的雙重偏見風險評估。證據確定性(COE)由1名審核人員評估，並由第二名審核人員過度閱讀。

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Ninety trials were included. COE was low to moderate for most comparisons. Compared with placebo, estrogens with or without progestogens, conjugated estrogen with bazedoxifene (CE/BZA), and oxybutynin reduced VMS frequency and severity. Compared with placebo, neurokinin receptor antagonists (NKRAs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), gabapentin, and progestogens reduced VMS frequency but not severity. Estrogen efficacy varied by dose but not route. Estrogens with and without progestogens, CE/BZA, NKRAs, SNRIs, and SSRIs improved menopause-related QoL; gabapentin, NKRAs, oxybutynin, SNRIs, and SSRIs improved sleep quality. Few SAEs were reported. Evidence was insufficient for patient values and preferences. Estrogens with or without progestogens are of high economic value (high COE). The NKRA fezolinetant has low value (moderate COE).
abstract.textZh: 納入了九十項試驗。大多數比較的COE為低至中等。與安慰劑相比，有或沒有孕激素的雌激素、與巴塞多昔芬（ CE/BZA ）結合的雌激素和奧昔布寧降低了VMS的頻率和嚴重程度。與安慰劑相比，神經激肽受體拮抗劑（ NKRA ）、血清素去甲腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑（ SNRI ）、選擇性血清素再攝取抑制劑（ SSRI ）、加巴噴丁和孕激素降低了VMS頻率，但不降低嚴重程度。雌激素療效因劑量而異，但不因途徑而異。含有和不含孕激素的雌激素、CE/BZA、NKRA、SNRI和SSRI改善了更年期相關的QOL ；加巴噴丁、NKRA、奧昔布寧、SNRI和SSRI改善了睡眠質量。報告的嚴重不良事件很少。證據不足以反映患者的價值觀和偏好。有或沒有孕激素的雌激素具有高經濟價值（高COE ）。NKRA fezolinetant具有低值（中度COE ）。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Most studies were short-term and were not designed to evaluate SAEs or long-term harms. Observational studies that could address long-term harms were not included.
abstract.textZh: 大多數研究都是短期的，並非用於評估嚴重不良事件或長期危害。不包括可以解決長期危害的觀察性研究。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Estrogens reduced VMS frequency and severity and improved QoL (with or without progestogens and with BZA). NKRAs, SNRIs, and SSRIs improved VMS frequency, QoL, and sleep. Estrogens with and without progestogens were of high economic value. Harms data were limited. Little comparative information exists.
abstract.textZh: 雌激素降低了VMS的頻率和嚴重程度，並改善了QOL （有或沒有孕激素和BZA ）。NKRA、SNRI和SSRI改善了VMS頻率、QOL和睡眠。含有和不含孕激素的雌激素具有很高的經濟價值。危害數據有限。對比信息很少。
