articles.title: Unpacking barriers to and facilitators for research leadership for Black primary care researchers: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Bajwa RK, Bains M, Mallen CD, Kai J, Agyemang-Benneh AF, Akyea RK

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Individuals of Black heritage comprise 6.2% of the general practice workforce in the UK. Representation is even lower in primary care research. The understanding of why this misrepresentation exists is limited.
abstract.textZh: 黑人血統的個人佔英國一般執業勞動力的6.2 ％。初級保健研究中的代表性更低。對這種虛假陳述存在的原因的理解有限。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore representation of researchers of Black heritage at various career stages within primary care, alongside factors influencing retention and career advancement.
abstract.textZh: 探索黑人傳統研究人員在初級保健各個職業階段的代表性，以及影響保留和職業發展的因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative study with 18 researchers of Black heritage and seven primary care senior academic leaders (current or former heads of primary care departments in UK universities).
abstract.textZh: 對18名黑人傳統研究人員和7名初級保健高級學術領袖（英國大學現任或前任初級保健部門負責人）進行定性研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Online, one-to-one, semi-structured interviews. Interviews were digitally audio-recorded, transcribed, and analysed using thematic analysis.
abstract.textZh: 線上、一對一、半結構化面試。採訪使用主題分析進行數位錄音、轉錄和分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants recognised significant underrepresentation of researchers of Black heritage in primary care research. Key barriers to career progression and retention included systemic and structural inequities, racism, and exclusionary academic culture. Facilitators included proactive leadership, tailored training and support for researchers (including international scholars), mentorship, sponsorship, and safe networking spaces. Participants offered recommendations to improve representation and career progression: training for leaders to recognise bias, discrimination, and inequity; leadership development opportunities; tailored career support for researchers of Black heritage; and targeted assistance for international researchers navigating UK academic systems. Visibility of Black role models in academic primary care was seen as essential to attracting and inspiring future researchers.
abstract.textZh: 參與者認識到黑人傳統研究人員在初級保健研究中的代表性顯著不足。職業發展和保留的主要障礙包括系統性和結構性的不平等、種族主義和排斥性的學術文化。培訓人員包括主動領導、為研究人員（包括國際學者）量身打造的培訓和支持、指導、贊助和安全的網絡空間。參與者提供了改善代表性和職業發展的建議：培訓領導者認識偏見、歧視和不公平；領導力發展機會；為黑人遺產研究人員提供量身定制的職業支持；以及為英國學術體系中的國際研究人員提供有針對性的協助。在學術初級護理中，黑人榜樣的能見度被視為吸引和激勵未來研究人員的必要條件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: These findings highlight key areas for change to foster a more inclusive and equitable research environment in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 這些研究結果強調了需要改變的關鍵領域，以促進初級保健領域更具包容性和公平性的研究環境。

articles.titleZh: 揭開黑人初級保健研究人員領導研究的障礙和促進因素：定性研究

articles.title: Impact of local enhanced incentive schemes on the performance of general practices within the UK: a systematic review
articles.authors: Conroy M, McManus E, Whittaker W, Bower P, Anderson M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: To drive improvements in healthcare quality and to reduce inequalities, pay-for-performance (P4P) schemes have become widespread internationally. In recent years, most local commissioning bodies in the UK have developed their own local general practice incentive schemes.
abstract.textZh: 為了推動醫療保健質量的改善並減少不平等，按績效付費（ P4P ）計劃已在國際上廣泛使用。近年來，英國大多數當地調試機構都制定了自己的當地全科醫生獎勵計劃。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine the use and effectiveness of local incentive schemes and their alignment to the national Quality and Outcomes Framework.
abstract.textZh: 檢查當地激勵計劃的使用和有效性，以及它們與國家質量和成果框架的一致性。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Systematic review of quantitative studies related to local incentive schemes with a P4P structure within UK general practice published after 2004.
abstract.textZh: 在2004年後出版的英國一般實踐中，對與具有P4P結構的當地激勵計劃相關的定量研究進行系統審查。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Searches were conducted via Ovid across the Embase and MEDLINE databases. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Effective Practice and Organisation of Care criteria and a narrative synthesis was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 透過Ovid在Embase和MEDLINE資料庫中進行搜尋。使用Cochrane Effective Practice and Organisation of Care標準評估偏倚風險，並進行敘事綜合。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 17 studies were identified, which were focused on 14 local incentive schemes. All studies were from England, except one from Scotland. Five studies included only tailored indicators, and seven studies included both aligned and tailored indicators. Quality assessment suggested the current evidence was of mixed quality. All studies that reported on process measures (n = 15) demonstrated positive impacts, but health outcome measures were only evaluated in nine studies showing inconsistent findings. Eight studies addressed impact on health inequalities and no studies addressed cost-effectiveness, patient-reported outcomes, or experience measures.
abstract.textZh: 總共確定了17項研究，這些研究集中在14個當地激勵計劃。除了一項來自蘇格蘭的研究外，所有的研究都來自英格蘭。五項研究僅包括量身定制的指標，七項研究包括對齊和量身定制的指標。質量評估表明，目前的證據質量好壞參半。所有報告過程測量值（ n = 15 ）的研究都顯示出積極影響，但只有9項研究評估了健康結果測量值，顯示出不一致的結果。八項研究涉及對健康不平等的影響，但沒有研究涉及成本效益、患者報告的結果或經驗測量。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: There is an emerging evidence base that local incentive schemes in general practice lead to improvements in process measures, although methodological quality of studies is mixed. Future studies should utilise more robust methods to evaluate effectiveness and examine impacts on health inequalities, cost-effectiveness, and variation by practice.
abstract.textZh: 有一個新興的證據基礎表明，一般實踐中的當地激勵計劃導致過程措施的改善，儘管研究的方法質量好壞參半。未來的研究應利用更健全的方法來評估有效性，並研究對健康不平等、成本效益和實踐差異的影響。

articles.titleZh: 當地強化獎勵計劃對英國一般實踐表現的影響：系統審查

articles.title: 'I have no idea who does the bone thing': a qualitative exploration to improve osteoporosis care
articles.authors: Heaven A, Kime N, Shafiq S, Harrison N, Connor J, Johansson JF, Teale E, Sharp C

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The Women's Health Strategy for England highlighted the systemic underrepresentation of older women in health care. Over half of women >80 years are estimated to have osteoporosis, contributing to 180 000 fractures annually in the UK, with substantial personal and economic costs, despite clinically effective treatments and national guidelines being available.
abstract.textZh: 英格蘭婦女健康戰略強調了老年婦女在醫療保健方面的系統性代表性不足。據估計，超過一半> 80歲的女性患有骨質疏鬆症，在英國每年導致18萬例骨折，儘管有臨牀有效的治療方法和國家指南，但仍有大量的個人和經濟成本。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To use insights from the experiences of older women and primary healthcare professionals to develop strategies to improve osteoporosis care.
abstract.textZh: 根據老年婦女和初級保健專業人員的經驗，制定改善骨質疏鬆症護理的策略。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A community-based qualitative study in England, UK.
abstract.textZh: 英國英格蘭一項以社區為基礎的定性研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Interviews were undertaken with 30 community-dwelling older women (aged ≥70 years) diagnosed with osteoporosis and 31 healthcare professionals including GPs, physiotherapists, pharmacists, practice nurses, a healthcare assistant, and a community matron. We reviewed findings iteratively with our coproduction group using a constructivist grounded theory approach.
abstract.textZh: 採訪了30名被診斷患有骨質疏鬆症的社區居住老年婦女（年齡≥ 70歲）和31名醫療保健專業人員，包括全科醫生、物理治療師、藥劑師、執業護士、醫療保健助理和社區護理師。我們使用建構主義基礎理論方法與共同生產小組疊代審查結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Healthcare professionals acknowledged osteoporosis as clinically important but described limited knowledge and understanding. However, older women assumed expertise and proactive engagement from clinicians. Older women normalised symptoms as part of ageing, frequently prioritising other comorbidities. Most were unclear about their diagnosis, prognosis, or treatment plans. Self-management was expected but inadequately supported. There was little routine engagement with the wider primary care team. Digital communication further limited older women's engagement/re-engagement.
abstract.textZh: 醫療保健專業人員承認骨質疏鬆症具有臨牀重要性，但描述的知識和理解有限。然而，年齡較大的婦女承擔了臨牀醫生的專業知識和積極參與。老年婦女將症狀正常化為衰老的一部分，經常優先考慮其他合併症。大多數人不清楚自己的診斷、預後或治療計劃。預期會有自我管理，但支援不足。與更廣泛的初級保健團隊的例行互動很少。數位溝通進一步限制了老年婦女的參與/重新參與。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Osteoporosis remains poorly understood and inadequately managed in older women who face barriers, including multimorbidity, digital exclusion, and low self-efficacy. Many older women accept care gaps owing to limited awareness and lack of meaningful interaction with healthcare professionals. Improved care navigation and greater involvement of the wider primary care team could enhance engagement and support better self-management.
abstract.textZh: 在面臨多重疾病、數位排斥和自我效能感低等障礙的老年婦女中，骨質疏鬆症仍然知之甚少，管理不當。由於意識有限和缺乏與醫療保健專業人員的有意義的互動，許多老年婦女接受護理差距。改進的護理導航和更廣泛的初級護理團隊的更多參與可以提高參與度並支持更好的自我管理。

articles.titleZh: “我不知道誰在做骨骼工作” ：改善骨質疏鬆症護理的定性探索

articles.title: Patient, pharmacist, and GP perspectives on identifying and managing polypharmacy: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Tsang JY, Blakeman T, Sperrin M, Kallis TJ, Payne RA, Ashcroft DM

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Polypharmacy is a global priority owing to potential harms, including adverse drug events, hospitalisations, and high treatment burden. Overall, these outcomes have shown little improvement despite numerous interventions, indicating that current approaches to identify and manage polypharmacy remain insufficient.
abstract.textZh: 由於潛在的危害，包括藥物不良事件、住院治療和高治療負擔，複方藥劑是全球優先事項。總體而言，儘管採取了許多幹預措施，但這些結果幾乎沒有改善，這表明目前識別和管理多種藥物的方法仍然不足。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To understand how polypharmacy is identified and managed in everyday primary care from patient, pharmacist, and GP perspectives.
abstract.textZh: 從患者、藥劑師和全科醫生的角度了解如何在日常初級護理中識別和管理多種藥物。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative semi-structured interviews were conducted with 12 patients and 12 professionals (seven clinical pharmacists and five GPs) across Greater Manchester, UK.
abstract.textZh: 對英國大曼徹斯特地區的12名患者和12名專業人員（ 7名臨牀藥劑師和5名全科醫生）進行了定性半結構化訪談。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Reflexive thematic analysis was undertaken, which was supported by normalisation process theory and constant comparison as sensitisation tools.
abstract.textZh: 進行了反射性主題分析，這得到了歸一化過程理論和作為敏化工具的不斷比較的支持。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Polypharmacy was widely seen as important work but, in practice, inconsistent case-finding and unclear purposes for polypharmacy medication reviews were reported. Patients viewed medications as essential tools to sustain biopsychosocial elements of life, contrasting with practitioners' clinical priorities to mitigate potential harm. Polypharmacy work routinely contained layers of hidden complexity, which was often overwhelming and placed a heavy emotional burden on patients and professionals. Both patients and professionals required training and experience to effectively manage these complexities. Although a protocol-driven approach was sufficient for simple medication issues, only a longer-term approach, predicated on trust, continuity, relationships, and open discussions encouraging healthy conflict, appeared to engage with deeper complexities.
abstract.textZh: 多種藥物被廣泛認為是重要的工作，但在實踐中，報告了多種藥物藥物審查的不一致的案例發現和不明確的目的。患者將藥物視為維持生命中生物心理社會要素的重要工具，與從業人員減輕潛在危害的臨牀優先事項形成對比。複方藥房工作通常包含多層隱藏的複雜性，這通常是壓倒性的，並給患者和專業人員帶來沉重的情感負擔。患者和專業人員都需要培訓和經驗來有效地管理這些複雜性。雖然協議驅動的方法足以處理簡單的藥物問題，但只有基於信任、連續性、關係和鼓勵健康衝突的公開討論的長期方法，似乎會涉及更深層次的複雜性。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Polypharmacy work is fraught with complexity and uncertainty, lacking standardised case-finding and clear purpose for both patients and professionals. Better models of care are needed to meet this challenge, encouraging a shift beyond a biomedically dominated protocol-driven approach to a more longitudinal and relational approach.
abstract.textZh: 複方藥房工作充滿了複雜性和不確定性，缺乏標準化的個案調查和對患者和專業人員的明確目的。需要更好的護理模式來應對這一挑戰，鼓勵從生物醫學主導的協議驅動方法轉向更縱向和關聯的方法。

articles.titleZh: 患者、藥劑師和全科醫生對識別和管理多種藥物的觀點：一項定性研究

articles.title: Fighting to be heard: a thematic analysis of parent perspectives on safety in UK general practice
articles.authors: Purchase T, Quinn-Scoggins HD, McFadzean IJ, Donovan L, Hope I, Clarke E, Lifford KJ, Hodson N, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Children are particularly vulnerable to healthcare-associated harm. Parents play a vital but under-recognised protective role in paediatric patient safety. Parent perceptions of and contributions to safety improvement efforts within hospital settings are well documented, but little is known about parent experiences and perspectives in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 兒童特別容易受到與醫療保健相關的傷害。父母在兒科患者安全方面起著至關重要但未被認可的保護作用。家長對醫院環境中安全改善工作的看法和貢獻有據可查，但對家長在初級保健方面的經驗和觀點知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore diverse parental perspectives on paediatric safety in primary care and identify target areas for improvement.
abstract.textZh: 探索父母對初級護理中兒科安全的不同觀點，並確定需要改善的目標領域。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This qualitative study in UK primary care was conducted through online (n = 2) and in-person (n = 2) workshops with parents, taking place between 24 June and 8 July 2024.
abstract.textZh: 這項在英國初級保健的定性研究是透過2024年6月24日至7月8日期間與家長進行的線上（ n = 2 ）和面對面（ n = 2 ）研討會進行的。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Workshops were structured around a descriptive analysis of paediatric patient safety incident reports in general practice. Parents discussed and reflected on their own experiences in relation to the findings. Transcripts and field notes were analysed thematically to identify key themes.
abstract.textZh: 研討會是圍繞一般實踐中兒科患者安全事件報告的描述性分析而組織的。父母討論並反思他們自己與調查結果相關的經驗。對成績單和現場筆記進行了主題分析，以確定關鍵主題。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Parents (n = 33) from varied backgrounds, including under-served communities, participated. Three major themes were identified: responsibility of care, highlighting perceived unclear roles between parents and healthcare teams; navigating the system, where parents described the need to 'fight' for care and the challenges of understanding healthcare processes; and communication and language, emphasising the difficulties of being heard, especially among ethnic minority parents and those lacking the confidence to speak up.
abstract.textZh: 來自不同背景（包括服務不足的社區）的父母（ n = 33 ）參與。確定了三個主要主題：護理責任，強調父母和醫療團隊之間感知不清晰的角色；在系統中導航，父母描述了為護理而「鬥爭」的必要性以及理解醫療保健過程的挑戰；以及溝通和語言，強調被傾聽的困難，特別是在少數族裔父母和缺乏信心說話的人中。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Parent perspectives on paediatric safety in primary care have highlighted key areas for practices, researchers, and safety improvement teams to target system change and intervention development. Engaging parents as co-designers in these efforts could enhance trust, reduce risk, and improve safety outcomes for paediatric patients.
abstract.textZh: 家長對初級護理兒科安全的觀點突出了實踐、研究人員和安全改進團隊的關鍵領域，以針對系統變革和幹預發展。讓父母作為共同設計者參與這些工作可以增強信任，降低風險，並改善兒科患者的安全結果。

articles.titleZh: 爭取被聽取：英國一般實踐中家長對安全的觀點的主題分析

articles.title: Primary care cardiovascular risk reduction after pregnancy complications: a qualitative systematic review
articles.authors: Hodges VJ, Shareef S, Chew-Graham CA, Wu P, Adetola M, Mitchell CA

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) affect approximately 30% of pregnancies and confer lifelong elevated cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk. Behavioural interventions may mitigate this risk.

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To systematically review qualitative literature on women's experiences of behavioural change for cardiovascular risk reduction following APOs, with a focus on health equity.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative systematic review, limited to high-income countries with universal access to health care.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and CINAHL from inception to March 2025 identified primary studies. Thematic synthesis followed Thomas and Harden's three-stage approach. Themes were mapped onto the COM-B (Capability, Opportunity, Motivation-Behaviour) framework to theoretically ground and structure analysis.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Eighteen studies involving 339 women met inclusion criteria. Women who were minority ethnic formed the majority in only two studies. Demographic data regarding socioeconomic status, ethnicity, or both were absent from five. Experiences shaping behaviour change aligned with COM-B domains. Delayed physical and psychological recovery after APOs reduced women's capability to initiate changes. Competing demands, including childcare, household responsibilities, and work, restricted opportunity to focus on long-term cardiovascular health. Opportunities improved when behaviour changes were easily integrated into family life and offered shared benefits. Motivation was strengthened by awareness of increased CVD risk, the responsibilities of parenthood, and personalised advice from healthcare professionals. Tailored, proactive follow-up supported engagement, especially for minority ethnic and socioeconomically disadvantaged groups.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Prevention of CVD after APOs requires structured, system-level support to prioritise family-based behaviour change. High-risk groups are underrepresented in research; coproducing interventions with these groups may help to avoid widening health inequalities.

articles.title: Survodutide Once Weekly in Adults with Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes
articles.authors: Wharton S, le Roux CW, Startseva E, Kloer IM, Alhussein A, Hussain SA, Unseld A, Bozkurt B, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: For persons living with both type 2 diabetes and obesity, weight management may be the most effective therapy for type 2 diabetes. Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists have potent weight-reducing effects, and other mechanisms may confer additional benefits. Survodutide is an investigational glucagon receptor-GLP-1 receptor dual agonist with potential weight-reducing and metabolic benefits.
abstract.textZh: 對於2型糖尿病和肥胖症患者，體重管理可能是2型糖尿病最有效的治療方法。胰高血糖素樣肽-1 （ GLP-1 ）受體激動劑具有強大的減肥作用，其他機制可能會帶來額外的益處。Survodutide是一種研究性胰高血糖素受體-GLP-1受體雙重激動劑，具有潛在的減肥和代謝益處。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multinational, double-blind, phase 3 trial involving adults with type 2 diabetes and a body-mass index (BMI; the weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters) of 27 or more, we randomly assigned participants in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive once-weekly subcutaneous survodutide (3.6 mg or 6.0 mg) or placebo. The two primary end points were the percent change in body weight and a reduction in body weight of at least 5% from baseline to week 76.
abstract.textZh: 在這項涉及患有2型糖尿病且體重指數（ BMI ；體重以公斤除以身高平方米為單位）為27或以上的成人進行的多國雙盲3期試驗中，我們以1: 1: 1的比例隨機分配參與者接受每週一次的皮下survodutide （ 3.6毫克或6.0毫克）或安慰劑。兩個主要終點是從基線到第76週的體重變化百分比和體重減少至少5%。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 752 participants (250 in the 3.6-mg survodutide group, 251 in the 6.0-mg survodutide group, and 251 in the placebo group), the mean age at baseline was 55.7 years, and the mean BMI was 36.5; 49.3% were men. The mean weight change at week 76 according to the treatment-regimen estimand (which assessed effects regardless of whether the trial regimen was discontinued or interrupted or whether other antiobesity therapies were used) was -8.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], -9.2 to -7.2) in the 3.6-mg group, -9.8% (95% CI, -10.8 to -8.8) in the 6.0-mg group, and -3.9% (95% CI, -4.9 to -2.9) in the placebo group; weight reduction of at least 5% occurred in 57.6%, 64.5%, and 35.1% of the participants, respectively (P<0.001 for all comparisons with placebo). The mean change in the glycated hemoglobin level (from a baseline level of 7.4%) was -0.9 percentage points in the 3.6-mg group, -0.8 percentage points in the 6.0-mg group, and -0.2 percentage points in the placebo group. The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal (generally mild to moderate and transient), which occurred in 182 participants (72.8%) in the 3.6-mg group, 195 (77.7%) in the 6.0-mg group, and 97 (38.6%) in the placebo group.
abstract.textZh: 在752名參與者（ 3.6-mg survodutide組250名、6.0-mg survodutide組251名、安慰劑組251名）中，基線時的平均年齡為55.7歲，平均BMI為36.5 ； 49.3%為男性。 根據治療方案的估計數據（無論試驗方案是否中斷或是否使用其他抗肥胖療法，評估療效） ，第76週的平均體重變化在3.6-mg組中為-8.2% （ 95%置信區間[CI] ， -9.2至-7.2 ） ，在6.0-mg組中為-9.8% （ 95% CI ， -10.8至-8.8 ） ，在安慰劑組中為-3.9% （ 95% CI ， -4.9至-2.9 ） ； 57.6%、64.5%和35.1%的參與者體重減輕至少5% （與安慰劑的所有比較為P < 0.001 ）。 糖化血紅蛋白水平的平均變化（基線水平為7.4% ）在3.6毫克組中為-0.9個百分點，在6.0毫克組中為-0.8個百分點，在安慰劑組中為-0.2個百分點。 最常見的不良事件是胃腸道（一般為輕度至中度和短暫） ，發生在3.6毫克組的182名參與者（ 72.8 ％ ）、6.0毫克組的195名參與者（ 77.7 ％ ）和安慰劑組的97名參與者（ 38.6 ％ ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes, survodutide at a weekly dose of 3.6 mg or 6.0 mg resulted in significantly greater weight reduction than placebo. (Funded by Boehringer Ingelheim; SYNCHRONIZE-2 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06066528.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有肥胖症和2型糖尿病的成年人中，每週劑量為3.6 mg或6.0 mg的survodutide比安慰劑導致顯著更大的體重減輕。（由勃林格殷格翰資助； SYNCHRONIZE-2 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06066528 ）。

articles.titleZh: 肥胖和2型糖尿病成人每周一次Survodutide

articles.title: Clinical empathy and relational continuity mitigate care fragmentation for patients with multiple long-term conditions: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Arakelyan S, Guthrie B, Anand A, Lone N, Mercer SW, Tooman T

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Services for patients with multiple long-term conditions (MLTC) operate within fragmented and poorly coordinated systems but how care experiences, perceptions, and behaviours emerge and adapt in response to service changes and increasing system complexity is poorly understood.
abstract.textZh: 為患有多種長期病症（ MLTC ）的患者提供的服務在支離破碎且協調不佳的系統中運作，但人們對護理體驗、觀念和行為如何因應服務變化和系統複雜性增加而產生和適應知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore how experiences and perceptions of care for patients with MLTC and their carers emerge and evolve within a complex adaptive care system to identify opportunities for better care.
abstract.textZh: 探索MLTC患者及其護理人員的護理經驗和觀念如何在複雜的適應性護理系統中出現和發展，以確定更好的護理機會。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Qualitative analysis of six focus groups with 28 patients with MLTC and carers in four Scottish integrated health and social care partnerships was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 對四個蘇格蘭綜合健康和社會護理合作夥伴關係中的六個焦點小組（包括28名MLTC患者和護理人員）進行了定性分析。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data were collected between February and May 2024. Abductive analysis informed by a complex adaptive systems lens was used.
abstract.textZh: 資料收集於2024年2月至5月之間。使用由複雜自適應系統晶狀體提供的外展分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Care for patients with MLTC emerged through dynamic, reciprocal interactions between patients, carers, professionals, and organisational structures. Service changes introduced to manage rising demand were often perceived as misaligned with patients' complex needs, prompting patients and carers to modify their behaviours to navigate access barriers. Care experiences were unpredictable, shaped by reinforcing feedback loops in which small personal interactions had a disproportionate effect on trust and engagement. Informal care expanded to fill system gaps, with family members assuming coordination and advocacy roles. Clinical empathy and relational continuity of care acted as key stabilising influences within fragmented care systems.
abstract.textZh: 對MLTC患者的護理透過患者、護理人員、專業人員和組織結構之間的動態、互惠互動而出現。為管理不斷增長的需求而引入的服務變更通常被認為與患者的複雜需求不符，促使患者和護理人員修改其行為以克服出入障礙。照護體驗是不可預測的，由強化的反饋迴路形成，其中小的個人互動對信任和參與度產生不成比例的影響。非正式護理擴大到填補系統空白，由家庭成員擔任協調和倡導角色。臨牀同理心和護理的關係連續性在支離破碎的護理系統中起著關鍵的穩定影響作用。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Service changes intended to improve care efficiency can inadvertently destabilise care and shift the burden onto patients with MLTC and their carers, affecting perceived care quality and relational continuity. The quality of interactions and relationships between agents shape patients' perceptions of care and future engagement.
abstract.textZh: 旨在提高護理效率的服務變化可能會無意中破壞護理，並將負擔轉嫁給MLTC患者及其護理人員，影響感知護理質量和關係連續性。客服人員之間的互動和關係的品質會影響患者對照護和未來參與的看法。

articles.titleZh: 臨牀同理心和關係連續性減輕多重長期病症患者的護理碎片：定性研究

articles.title: Cost savings from primary care clinic continuity among patients with chronic disease in Alberta, Canada: a retrospective population-level cross-sectional study
articles.authors: McDonald T, Lethebe BC, Green LA

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Continuity of care with a primary care physician (PCP) is well known to improve patient health, result in less health service utilisation (HSU), and lower costs. Less is known about the impact of clinic continuity related to team-based care and shared practice models. Information on the cost impact of such models is needed to guide design and payment policies.
abstract.textZh: 眾所周知，初級護理醫生（ PCP ）的持續護理可以改善患者健康，減少醫療服務利用率（ HSU ）並降低成本。與團隊式照護和共享實踐模式相關的診所連續性的影響知之甚少。需要有關此類模式的成本影響的資訊，以指導設計和付款政策。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To estimate savings in HSU costs for patients with chronic disease when they are moved from primary care clinics with low and moderate continuity levels to those with high levels.
abstract.textZh: 估計慢性病患者從低和中等連續性水平的初級保健診所轉移到高水平的診所時， HSU成本的節省。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A 3-year retrospective population based cross-sectional study examined the HSU costs associated with three levels of primary care clinic continuity for approximately 70 000 matched patients from a cohort of 500 000 patients with chronic disease in Alberta, Canada. All fee-for-service PCPs were included.
abstract.textZh: 一項為期3年的回溯性人羣橫斷面研究檢查了加拿大亞伯達省500,000名慢性病患者隊列中約70,000名匹配患者與三級初級保健診所連續性相關的HSU成本。所有收費的五氯苯酚都包括在內。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Clinic continuity was calculated by adapting the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index. Costs were estimated using costing methodologies from the Canadian Institute of Health Information.
abstract.textZh: 診所連續性是通過調整常規護理提供者（ UPC ）指數來計算的。使用加拿大健康信息研究所的成本估算方法估算成本。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The association between continuity and acute care costs suggests achieving high clinic continuity (UPC 80-100%) for all 195 000 patients in less than high clinic continuity care could theoretically yield upwards of £898 million over 3 years. Estimated per-patient gains were highest among the most medically complex patients.
abstract.textZh: 連續性與急性照護成本之間的關聯表明，在低於高診所連續性照護的所有195,000名患者中實現高診所連續性（ UPC 80-100 ％ ）理論上可以在3年內產生高達8.98億£的收益。在醫學上最複雜的患者中，每位患者的預估增益最高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Cost savings were associated with clinic continuity among patients with common chronic diseases at all levels of complexity. Significant cost savings could be realised by focusing patient care on primary care clinics that favour high levels of continuity.
abstract.textZh: 在所有複雜程度的常見慢性疾病患者中，成本節省與診所的連續性有關。通過將患者護理專注於有利於高度連續性的初級護理診所，可以實現顯著的成本節省。

articles.titleZh: 加拿大亞伯達省慢性病患者初級保健診所連續性節省的成本：一項回顧性人羣水平橫斷面研究

articles.title: Sustaining named GP continuity requires organisational change: a comparative implementation analysis in Finland
articles.authors: Tuompo W, Mäkelä J, Timonen M, Auvinen J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maintaining doctor-patient relationship continuity remains a challenge in public primary care in Finland and internationally owing to GP workforce pressures and organisational constraints.
abstract.textZh: 由於全科醫生的勞動力壓力和組織限制，維持醫患關係的連續性仍然是芬蘭和國際公共初級保健的挑戰。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate implementation of a named GP model and explain differences in implementation outcomes between two Finnish primary care units.
abstract.textZh: 評估指定的全科醫生模式的實施情況，並解釋芬蘭兩個初級保健單位之間實施結果的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A quasi-experimental before-after study was conducted in two Finnish primary care units with contrasting organisational settings. Patients were assigned a named GP responsible for non-urgent care. Electronic health record data covering physician consultations over 48 months were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩個芬蘭初級保健單位中進行了準實驗性事前事後研究，組織環境形成對比。患者被指派負責非緊急護理的指定全科醫生。分析了涵蓋48個月內醫師會診的電子健康記錄數據。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Continuity was measured using the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index, the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), and the Own Patient Ratio (OPR). Implementation outcomes were interpreted using the RE-AIM framework. A segmented interrupted time series model was applied to OPR and SLICC, and UPC analysed using a pre-post design.
abstract.textZh: 使用普通護理提供者（ UPC ）指數、聖倫納德護理持續性指數（ SLICC ）和自身患者比率（ OPR ）來測量連續性。實施結果使用RE-AIM框架來解釋。將分段中斷時間序列模型應用於OPR和SLICC ，並使用前後設計分析UPC。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Named GP continuity was higher in Tuira than in Pudasjärvi across all measures. In Tuira, adoption (OPR 0.88) was high and stable with lower named GP-level variation, while reach (SLICC 0.31) and effectiveness (UPC 0.35) improved but remained modest. Although continuity improved in Pudasjärvi, adoption remained weaker (OPR 0.40), reach lower (SLICC 0.16), and maintenance less stable. Continuity of care with physicians other than the named GP increased more in Pudasjärvi.
abstract.textZh: 在所有措施中， Tuira的命名GP連續性都高於Pudasjärvi。在圖伊拉，採用率（ OPR 0.88 ）高且穩定， GP水平變化較低，而REACH （ SLICC 0.31 ）和有效性（ UPC 0.35 ）有所改善，但仍然適度。雖然Pudasjärvi的連續性有所改善，但採用率仍然較弱（ OPR 0.40 ） ，達到較低（ SLICC 0.16 ） ，維護不太穩定。在Pudasjärvi ，除了指定的全科醫生之外，其他醫生的持續護理增加更多。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The named GP model was functionally adopted in Tuira but remained largely nominal in Pudasjärvi. Health systems implementing named GP models should prioritise sustained GP presence and organisational alignment to achieve continuity.

articles.title: Family Medicine at the Forefront: Advancing Telemedicine for Opioid Use Disorder (TeleOUD) Through Access, Trust, and Community-Centered Care
articles.authors: Adepoju OE

abstract.text: Telemedicine for opioid use disorder (teleOUD) represents a critical opportunity to expand access to evidence-based treatment while reducing stigma and structural barriers that have long impeded recovery. Yet, gaps persist in awareness, education, and trust among both clinicians and patients. Family medicine, grounded in continuity, collaboration, and community-centered care, is uniquely positioned to close these gaps. By embedding teleOUD education into training programs, normalizing its use in primary care, and fostering interprofessional partnerships, family physicians can transform how OUD is treated and perceived. As teleOUD becomes an integral part of care delivery, the challenge ahead is not only technological adoption, but rebuilding trust, reshaping clinical culture, and ensuring that every patient can access treatment without fear or stigma.

articles.title: Why Are There Never Enough Family Physicians to Provide Care for the People of the United States?
articles.authors: Young RA

abstract.text: The US environment for healthcare and healthcare research is not conducive to providing adequate family physicians to care for the needs of the US population. Medical student interest in family medicine is discouraged by many factors, including the culture of medical schools; physician-payment realities, including the American Medical Association's (AMA) Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) codes; the rules by which Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) determines physician and hospital payments; a lack of family medicine research funding; and a favoritism of resources devoted to hospitals and partialists (specialists). Family medicine is also negatively impacted by the generally poor understanding of its value among US policy makers and health-system observers. Family physicians contribute to better population health at a lower total cost. But many policy makers and observers have internalized inaccurate assumptions and misunderstandings of: (a) the role of wellness and lifestyle education, (b) the limits of the triple aim and common preventive services and single-disease metrics, (c) the results of 50 years of cost-effectiveness research, (d) inattention to referral rates, (e) inadequate recognition of family physicians' knowledge and ability to work within complex healthcare systems for the benefit of their patients, and (f) an over-reliance on population management. The full potential of family medicine to make its most effective contributions will only emerge when these issues are addressed.

articles.title: The Joy Is in the Gray-The Problems Family Medicine Leaders Should Be Talking About
articles.authors: Young RA

abstract.text: Family medicine care in the United States has been suppressed through structural impediments in the healthcare system, yet could provide more care and better health outcomes with appropriate changes. The role of general practitioners in other developed countries provide insights on the value of primary care that could be better incorporated into US healthcare. The fundamental value of family physicians' care emerges from generalist thinking, particularly the use of probabilistic reasoning that supports care variation when patient preferences, situations, capabilities, as well as potential outcomes, are incorporated. Important strengths of family physicians include comfort with uncertainty, use of safety-netting, and listening to patient concerns and preferences, thereby providing balance in medical care decisions. These strengths occur through negotiating with patients to balance many concurrent considerations, reducing low-value care, establishing reasonable expectations with patients, providing a comprehensive basket of services, and continuing to function as a reservoir of resilience for the overall healthcare system. Efforts to grow US family medicine have been hampered by: (a) current measures of value-based care, (b) an over-emphasis on team-based care, and (c) some "un-American" aspects of family medicine culture, such as the belief that more care is not necessarily better care, that time can be used as a diagnostic tool, that it's important to be comfortable with mortality and end-of-life care, and being mindful of quaternary prevention. If family physicians communicate their value to patients and other stakeholders, and their unique strengths are better supported by stakeholders, patients will be better served, and future family physicians will have more joyful careers.

articles.title: Exercise Therapy and Education for Young Adults With Persistent Knee Problems After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction : A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Culvenor AG, Bruder AM, West TJ, Barton CJ, Roos EM, Oei EH, McPhail SM, Souza RB, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Chronic knee symptoms and early-onset osteoarthritis are common after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR). Evidence to inform management is needed.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate whether physiotherapist-supervised exercise therapy with education is superior to a single education session and self-directed exercise resource for young adults with persistent knee problems after ACLR.

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Parallel-group randomized trial. (Australian New Zealand Clinical Trials Registry: ACTRN12620001164987).

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Community.

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 184 young adults (aged 18 to 40 years) with persistent knee problems 9 to 36 months after ACLR.

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: A 4-month twice-weekly physiotherapist-supervised exercise therapy program with education (SUPER [SUpervised exercise-therapy and Patient Education Rehabilitation]; n = 92) and a single physiotherapist-delivered education session and self-directed exercise resource (control; n = 92).

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Primary outcome was 4-month change in the composite Knee injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score (KOOS4; 0= worst, 100= best). Secondary outcomes included KOOS4 at 12 months and thigh muscle strength, patient-perceived global rating of change, and cartilage thickness and composition on magnetic resonance imaging at 4 and 12 months.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: 184 participants were randomly assigned (mean age, 30 years [SD, 6]; 2.2 years [SD, 0.7] after ACLR); 178 (97%) and 174 (95%) completed 4-month and 12-month follow-up, respectively. At 4 months, KOOS4 scores improved more in the SUPER group than in the control group (14.1 vs. 9.4; adjusted mean difference, 4.8 [95% CI, 1.4 to 8.2]). At 4 months, SUPER resulted in greater muscle strength gains and higher rates of success on global rating of change (for example, pain 73% vs. 40%). Between-group differences narrowed at 12 months as the control group continued to improve, whereas SUPER gains were sustained. There were no between-group differences seen in cartilage thickness or composition.

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Unblinded participants.

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For young adults with persistent knee problems after ACLR, physiotherapist-supervised exercise therapy with education improved patient-reported outcomes compared with a single education session and self-directed exercise resource, but these between-group differences may not be sustained over time.

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: National Health and Medical Research Council.

articles.title: Prescriber Practices and Barriers to Providing Prescription Medication Instructions for Patients With a Non-English Language Preference
articles.authors: Manzor B, Ramírez JL, Lanchoney OWL, Collins V, Hughey KL

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Patients in the United States with limited English proficiency, referred to as a non-English language preference, are at risk for serious negative medication-related outcomes. Evidence suggests that these negative outcomes are associated with miscommunication of prescription medication instructions between prescribers and patients and between prescribers and dispensing pharmacies. We sought to explore relevant practices and barriers.
abstract.textZh: 美國英語水平有限的患者（稱為非英語偏好）有嚴重藥物相關不良結果的風險。有證據表明，這些負面結果與處方者和患者之間以及處方者和配藥藥房之間處方藥物說明溝通不暢有關。我們試圖探索相關做法和障礙。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We recruited outpatient prescribers from a large academic medical health center via an e-mail listserv. We developed and distributed a questionnaire to identify prescribers' practices, barriers, and interactions with patients, interpreters, and pharmacies regarding provision of non-English prescription medication instructions.
abstract.textZh: 我們通過電子郵件列表服務器從大型學術醫療保健中心招募門診處方師。我們開發並分發了一份問卷，以確定處方者在提供非英語處方藥物說明方面的做法、障礙以及與患者、口譯員和藥房的互動。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 477 e-mail addresses on the listserv, 169 (35.4%) prescribers completed the questionnaire. The prescribers were predominantly White (73.4%), female (75.7%), and physicians (doctors of medicine or doctors of osteopathic medicine, 86.0%), and they had an average age of 41.0 years. The majority (61.5%) reported a lack of awareness of best practices to provide non-English instructions to patients or pharmacies, and most (91.8%) did not inform patients that they could request a non-English medication label from their pharmacy. Many prescribers (69.8%) did not feel confident that their patients with a non-English language preference received accurate written medication instructions.

articles.title: What It Cost and What It Gave to Become an Undocumented Family Physician
articles.authors: Ruiz J

abstract.text: Growing up as an undocumented immigrant in North Carolina shaped not only the author's path to medicine, but also how they understand patients, systems, and belonging. In this reflective essay, they describe the fear, uncertainty, and exclusion that marked their medical training in the United States while undocumented, despite academic achievement and a longstanding desire to become a physician. Policies designed to limit opportunity repeatedly threatened their progression, not because they lacked ability, but because institutions often viewed undocumented trainees as a risk. Although Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) allowed them to continue training, instability and uncertainty persisted. Now practicing rural family medicine with obstetrics, the author recognizes similar fears and structural barriers in patients who delay or avoid care because of exclusion, vulnerability, or mistrust. This essay reflects on what being undocumented cost them, what it taught them about caring for patients at the margins of medicine and society, and what communities lose when systems confuse legality with worth.Abstract available in: عربي (Arabic); (Chinese); Francais (French); Deutsch (German); हिन्दी (Hindi); Indonesian (Indonesian); (Japanese); Portugues (Portuguese); Español (Spanish).

articles.authors: Harriett LE, Wright KM, Anderson L, Wheat S, Harrison L, Rowland K, Oshman L, Worringer E, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Quality improvement (QI) is a core component of family medicine residency training, preparing physicians to lead system-level changes and deliver value-based care. However, there is no standardized curriculum or metric for evaluating success of residency QI projects and a lack of consensus on best practices for QI education and assessment in graduate medical education. We sought to characterize the current landscape of QI curricula in US family medicine residencies, including pedagogic methods, project requirements, faculty roles, and perceived markers of success and barriers.

Survey question topics included QI training, project logistics, characteristics, and outcomes. We analyzed data by descriptive statistics and χ2 analyses.

articles.title: Identifying Hazardous Alcohol Use in Primary Care: Concordance Between Phosphatidylethanol and Self-Reports
articles.authors: Månsson V, Hammarberg A, Guterstam J, LoMartire R

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Screening for hazardous alcohol use is a challenging task in primary care. We examined concordance between the alcohol biomarker phosphatidylethanol (PEth) and 2 self-reported measures of alcohol use-score on a screening questionnaire and weekly drinks-in primary care.
abstract.textZh: 在初級保健中，篩查有害酒精使用是一項具有挑戰性的任務。我們檢查了酒精生物標誌物磷脂酰乙醇（ PEth ）和2項自我報告的酒精使用量度之間的一致性-篩選問卷和每週飲酒-初級保健。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using regional primary care health records linked to national registries in Sweden. Analyses used 2 samples: (1) patients with a PEth test who also had an Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (AUDIT) score in the preceding or following 90 days (n = 3,679) and (2) patients with a PEth test who also had a documented self-reported weekly alcohol use in the preceding or following 90 days (n = 8,934). We defined hazardous alcohol use as a PEth level of greater than 210 ng/mL (0.30 μmol/L), an AUDIT score of 8 or higher, and a reported consumption of 10 or more drinks per week. Associations between PEth and self-reports were examined using correlation analyses and proportional-odds models adjusted for sociodemographic and clinical characteristics.
abstract.textZh: 我們使用與瑞典國家登記處相關的區域初級保健健康記錄進行了回溯性隊列研究。分析使用了2個樣本： (1)在90天之前或之後也進行酒精使用障礙識別測試(AUDIT)評分的PEth測試患者(n = 3,679)和(2)在90天之前或之後也進行有記錄的每週自我報告酒精使用的PEth測試患者(n = 8,934)。我們將有害酒精使用定義為PEth水平高於210 ng/mL (0.30 μmol/L)、稽核分數為8分或更高，以及每週飲用10杯或更多飲料。使用相關性分析和根據社會人口和臨牀特徵調整的比例ODDS模型檢查PEth和自我報告之間的關聯。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The prevalence of hazardous alcohol use varied substantially by assessment method. The AUDIT questionnaire classified the largest proportion of patients as having hazardous use (26.5%), followed by PEth level (14.6% and 18.3% in the first and second samples, respectively) and by reported weekly drinks (8.5%). Each method identified patients not detected by the others. PEth levels correlated moderately with both AUDIT scores and weekly alcohol consumption, but relationships were nonlinear. At similar PEth levels, men and patients with higher education or income reported greater weekly alcohol use, while younger patients had higher AUDIT scores.
abstract.textZh: 使用有害酒精的普遍程度因評估方法而異。稽核問卷將最大比例的患者分類為有危險使用（ 26.5 ％ ） ，其次是PEth水平（第一和第二個樣本分別為14.6 ％和18.3 ％ ）以及每週報告的飲料（ 8.5 ％ ）。每種方法都能識別出其他方法未檢測到的患者。PEth水平與稽核分數和每週飲酒量均有中度相關性，但關係是非線性的。在類似的PEth水平下，受過高等教育或收入的男性和患者報告每週酒精使用量較高，而年輕患者的稽核分數較高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: An alcohol biomarker and self-reported measures capture overlapping but distinct aspects of alcohol use in primary care. For primary care clinicians, PEth should be interpreted alongside self-reported measures rather than used as a standalone test. Combining assessment methods may improve identification of alcohol-related risk and support more individualized, context-sensitive clinical conversations.
abstract.textZh: 酒精生物標誌物和自我報告的措施捕捉了初級保健中酒精使用的重疊但截然不同的方面。對於初級保健臨牀醫生， PEth應與自我報告的措施一起解釋，而不是用作獨立測試。結合評估方法可以改善酒精相關風險的識別，並支持更個性化、上下文敏感的臨牀對話。

articles.title: Assessing 5-Year Outcomes of a Teamlet Care Model in Singapore Polyclinics: A Matched Difference-in-Difference Analysis
articles.authors: Wye Wong SK, Tan KB, Pang J, Wong V, Liang Ng DW, Yung Tan DH, Lim Z, Sundram M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: A novel teamlet (small team) care model was introduced in 2014 within Singapore polyclinics to improve care continuity and comprehensiveness for patients with chronic disease. Patients were enrolled in smaller teams comprising 2 family physicians, 1 nurse, and 1 care coordinator for coordinated team-based care. This study assessed 5-year outcomes focusing on clinical parameters, care adherence, health care utilization, and economic impact.
abstract.textZh: 2014年，新加坡多家診所引入了一種新的teamlet （小團隊）護理模式，以改善慢性病患者的護理連續性和全面性。患者被招募到較小的團隊中，包括2名家庭醫生、1名護士和1名護理協調員，以協調團隊為基礎的護理。本研究評估了5年結果，重點是臨牀參數、護理依從性、醫療保健利用率和經濟影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a retrospective matched cohort study of patients with diabetes, hypertension, or hyperlipidemia enrolled in the teamlet program from 2014 to 2016. Outcomes were compared with matched control patients receiving usual care. We analyzed data from Singapore's Ministry of Health databases using difference-in-differences analysis, controlling for individual and cohort-time fixed effects.
abstract.textZh: 我們對2014年至2016年參與teamlet計劃的糖尿病、高血壓或高脂血症患者進行了回顧性匹配隊列研究。將結果與接受常規護理的匹配對照患者進行比較。我們使用差異分析來分析來自新加坡衛生部數據庫的數據，控制個人和隊列時間固定效應。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The teamlet model achieved modest clinical improvements; glycated hemoglobin decreased by 0.1% for subgroups with nonincreasing HbA1c before empanelment, systolic blood pressure decreased by 0.65 mm Hg, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol decreased by 0.03 mmol/L. However, diabetes screening adherence improved, with 16% more foot screenings and 6% more eye screenings compared with control patients. Health care utilization shifted toward primary care, with decreased inpatient hospitalizations (SGD $2,432 savings per person), decreased specialist outpatient visits (SGD $130 savings per person), fewer emergency department visits (SGD $49 savings per person), but increased polyclinic utilization cost (SGD $479 per person). Overall cost savings totaled SGD $2,186 per patient.

articles.title: AI-Enhanced Super-Resolution Handheld Ultrasound for Carotid Plaque Detection in Community Screening
articles.authors: Lan J, Liu S, Chen H, Zhang T, Zeng P, Li J, Jin L, Tan T, et al.

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death, and early identification of carotid atherosclerotic plaques is critical for stroke prevention in primary care and community settings. We examined whether artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced handheld ultrasound (HHUS) could improve carotid plaque detection and stenosis assessment in community-based primary care screening.
abstract.textZh: 缺血性中風是殘疾和死亡的主要原因，早期識別頸動脈粥樣硬化斑塊對於初級保健和社區環境中的中風預防至關重要。我們研究了人工智能（ AI ）增強型手持超聲波（ HHUS ）是否可以改善基於社區的初級保健篩查中的頸動脈斑塊檢測和狹窄評估。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We developed a super-resolution reconstruction model (Hyper-CycleGAN) and validated it in a clinical cohort of 127 patients with 198 plaques. The validated model was then applied in a community screening setting with 117 participants and 153 plaques, using portable ultrasound as the reference standard. We evaluated agreement with the reference standard (Bland-Altman, intraclass correlation coefficient) and community diagnostic performance (detection rates, quadratic-weighted Cohen κ, confusion matrices, and standard metrics).
abstract.textZh: 我們開發了一個超分辨率重建模型（ Hyper-CycleGAN ） ，並在127名患者與198個斑塊的臨牀隊列中進行了驗證。然後使用便攜式超聲波作為參考標準，將經過驗證的模型應用於有117名參與者和153個斑塊的社區篩選環境中。我們評估了與參考標準(Bland-Altman ，類內相關係數)和社區診斷績效(檢測率、二次加權Cohen κ、混淆矩陣和標準指標)的一致性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In community screening, AI-enhanced HHUS identified 94.8% of carotid plaques compared with 87.6% using standard HHUS. Agreement in stenosis grading with the reference standard improved, with weighted κ increasing from 0.492 to 0.836. Sensitivity for identifying ultrasound-defined vulnerable plaques increased from 47.4% to 63.2%, and specificity remained high.
abstract.textZh: 在社區篩選中， AI增強型HHUS鑑定出94.8%的頸動脈斑塊，而使用標準HHUS鑑定出87.6%的頸動脈斑塊。狹窄分級與參考標準的一致性得到改善，加權κ從0.492增加到0.836。識別超聲定義的脆弱斑塊的靈敏度從47.4%增加到63.2% ，特異性仍然很高。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: AI-enhanced HHUS improved carotid plaque detection and stenosis assessment in community screening, supporting more accurate risk stratification and referral decisions in primary care. This approach could expand access to low-cost stroke prevention strategies in underserved communities.Abstract available in: يبرع (Arabic); (Chinese); Francais (French); Deutsch (German); हिन्दी (Hindi); Indonesian (Indonesian); (Japanese); Portugues (Portuguese); Español (Spanish).

articles.title: Integrating Peer Support Into Medicare-Funded Care: A Qualitative Study of System-Level Insights From Early Implementation
articles.authors: Ferrin AA, Khudaier SE, Martinez J, Matz C, Cui S, Jabbarpour Y, Fortuna KL

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: In 2024, Medicare introduced principal illness navigation peer support (PIN-PS) reimbursement codes, creating the first nationwide reimbursement mechanism specifically for peer-delivered support services under Medicare. Little is known about early implementation of these codes. This study identified barriers and facilitators to PIN-PS adoption across clinical, organizational, and policy settings.
abstract.textZh: 2024年， Medicare引入了主要疾病導航同儕支援(PIN-PS)報銷代碼，創建了第一個全國性的報銷機制，專門為Medicare下的同儕提供支援服務。對於這些守則的早期實施知之甚少。本研究確定了在臨牀、組織和政策環境中採用PIN-PS的障礙和促進因素。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted semi-structured, qualitative interviews with 20 participants representing physicians, certified peer support specialists and leaders, policy professionals, payer representatives, and behavioral health or recovery organizational leaders. Interviews were analyzed using the Rigorous and Accelerated Data Reduction technique and guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research.
abstract.textZh: 我們對代表醫生、認證同儕支援專家和領導者、政策專業人士、付款人代表以及行為健康或恢復組織領導者的20名參與者進行了半結構化的定性訪談。採訪使用嚴格和加速數據減少技術進行分析，並在實施研究綜合框架的指導下進行。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Barriers included limited awareness of PIN-PS codes, administrative and billing complexity, cost-sharing requirements, and constraints in reimbursable service time. Facilitators included perceived benefits for care coordination and workflow, alignment with broader policy priorities, and organizational readiness to integrate peer support into care teams. Perspectives on implementation varied across clinical and organizational settings.

articles.title: Social Support in Group Medical Visits for Chronic Pain in Primary Care
articles.authors: Ko HJ, Jackson JLN, Thompson-Lastad A, Wennik J, Swedlow P, Chao MT

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Social support is associated with improved outcomes for people with chronic pain and is an important but understudied component of biopsychosocial pain care. We sought to explore how group medical visits facilitate 4 distinct types of social support-emotional, appraisal, informational, and instrumental-among primary care patients with chronic pain.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We collected qualitative data within a randomized trial of integrative group medical visits for chronic pain, focusing on 2 cohorts of English-speaking patients randomized to group medical visits. Data came from 16 observed group medical visits, 2 focus groups, and 12 semistructured interviews. The group medical visit intervention entailed 12 weekly sessions combining clinical care, pain education, mindfulness meditation, therapeutic movement, and facilitated discussion. We analyzed data using team-based flexible coding and codebook thematic analysis.

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The 26 participating patients were predominantly low-income (80.8% had an annual household income of less than $50,000); 50.0% identified as Black or African American, 15.4% as Hispanic or Latine, and 23.1% as White. On average, they had severe pain with a mean intensity rating of 7.7 out of 10. All 4 social support types emerged through structured program components (curriculum, facilitation strategies, program structure) and interactions among peers and facilitators. Emotional support fostered belonging and countered isolation and stigma. Appraisal support normalized struggles and fostered self-compassion. Informational support combined interactive education with peer-to-peer knowledge exchange. Instrumental support provided concrete assistance.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Our findings illustrate how group medical visits for chronic pain mobilize 4 interwoven and reinforcing forms of social support as core therapeutic processes. They also highlight group medical visits as a potential model for biopsychosocial chronic pain management among primary care patients.

articles.title: Influence of Physician Behaviors on How Patients Interpret Normal Test Results
articles.authors: Kube T, Seewald A

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Reassuring patients that nothing serious is wrong is one of the most common interventions in family medicine. However, medical reassurance can sometimes fail, and it is not yet clear what role the doctor's behavior plays in this regard. We tested the preregistered hypothesis that a doctor's warmth and competence significantly and independently influence patients' responses to normal results from diagnostic testing.
abstract.textZh: 向患者保證沒有任何嚴重問題是家庭醫學中最常見的幹預措施之一。然而，醫療保證有時會失敗，目前還不清楚醫生的行為在這方面扮演什麼角色。我們測試了預先註冊的假設，即醫生的溫暖和能力顯著且獨立地影響患者對診斷測試正常結果的反應。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We used an online convenience sample reporting medium somatic symptom burden (N = 349, mean age 29.9 years, 79% female) and completed an experimental analog study. After presentation of a symptom vignette, participants watched a videotaped medical report in which a doctor provided the results of diagnostic tests, stating that no abnormality had been identified. Whereas the diagnostic information was always the same, the doctor's behavior differed in terms of warmth (high vs low) and competence (high vs low).
abstract.textZh: 我們使用在線便利樣本報告中等軀體症狀負擔（ N = 349 ，平均年齡29.9歲， 79 ％為女性） ，並完成了一項實驗類比研究。在呈現症狀暈影後，參與者觀看了一份醫療報告錄像，其中醫生提供了診斷測試的結果，指出沒有發現異常。儘管診斷資訊始終相同，但醫生的行為在溫暖（高與低）和能力（高與低）方面有所不同。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants rated the likelihood of a serious disease significantly lower if the doctor showed high warmth and high competence. Further results showed that high warmth and competence also led to improvements in other outcomes, such as a lower desire to seek another doctor's opinion or additional tests. A mediation analysis indicated that the effects of warmth and competence were modulated by the extent to which participants cognitively (de)valued diagnostic information.
abstract.textZh: 如果醫生表現出高熱情和高能力，參與者對嚴重疾病的可能性評分顯著降低。進一步的結果表明，高熱情和能力也導致其他結果的改善，例如尋求另一位醫生的意見或額外測試的慾望降低。調解分析表明，溫暖和能力的影響受到參與者認知（去）價值診斷信息的程度的調節。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For patients, diagnostic information does not speak for itself; the doctor's behavior critically determines how they integrate such information. Showing high warmth and competence can help patients put trust in them and update their illness beliefs accordingly.
abstract.textZh: 對於患者來說，診斷資訊並不能說明一切；醫生的行為關鍵決定了他們如何整合這些資訊。展現高度的熱情和能力可以幫助患者信任他們，並相應地更新他們的疾病信念。
